**#120 v15 mid-roll ad-truncation FIX — field-test build (not an official release).**

Target: **Prime Video 6.23.23 + v15.5.0.70 only** (armeabi-v7a). Clone build (installs as `com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom.mod`).

**⚠️ This is NOT a v16 fix.** On 6.24.x (v16.0.0.x) the ad pipeline is native — this patch applies/installs cleanly there but will **not** suppress ads. Use only on 6.23.23+v15.5.0.70.

**What it fixes:** large mid-roll ad responses in aggressive-ad regions (India/EU) arrive split across memory chunks; the old code bailed and let the ad through (or buffer-locked into a freeze). This blanks each *complete* ad in a truncated chunk, leaving the half-copied tail alone.

**Install:** signed with the project release key — it will NOT update over a self-patched build in place (`SIGNATURES_DO_NOT_MATCH`). Uninstall the existing `.mod` first, then install (one-time re-login). Self-signers can re-sign with their own key for in-place updates.

**Confirming in logcat:** `PVKILL path=tv-trunc blanked=N` + climbing `rego_trunc` in the `[hb]` heartbeat.

# [4.2.0-dev.11](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/compare/v4.2.0-dev.10...v4.2.0-dev.11) (2026-08-03)


### Bug Fixes

* **YouTube - Hide ads:** Add missing filters ([d69d820](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/commit/d69d8207f573146693038ab5d3ef023df658df41))
Fixed login crash (register overflow), added main activity orientation fix (allows free rotation).
Auto-detect HMS Core: login now checks HMS Core availability at runtime and uses HMS sign-in when available, falling back to WebView when HMS Core is missing.
Fixed WebView login: forces AccountPicker to always use H5 WebView path, bypassing HMS Core checks that fail on non-Huawei devices.
Removed LSPosed module and logging code. Patches are now pure bytecode modifications with no runtime logging.
Breaking change: removed Android Auto support. Project now focuses solely on enabling Petal Maps on non-Huawei devices.

Add in-process display capture via reflection (IWindowManager.captureDisplay on API 34+, SurfaceControl for 29-33) with screencap/PixelCopy fallbacks — fast capture path once the companion LSPosed module unlocks hidden APIs.

Fix black map on the car: capture the COMPOSED virtual display via 'screencap -d' raw (SurfaceView/GL map included — PixelCopy of the window missed it). Header parse with endianness/length validation, auto fallback to PixelCopy, rate-limited path logging.

New render pipeline: the VirtualDisplay draws into its own ImageReader-backed buffer (decoupled from the car surface); a capture loop copies the projected window via PixelCopy every 500ms and draws it on the car surface with crop-to-fill — the letterboxed portrait is stretched to fill the landscape in software. Input goes through the inverse crop mapping. Last frame is kept on capture failure.

Remove forced car mode (power-off/lockscreen — natural behavior preferred) and attack the portrait letterbox: force SENSOR_LANDSCAPE in runtime on the projected activity + explicit resizeableActivity=true in the manifest. Window bounds logged 2s after orientation change for diagnosis.
Fix 100% crash (NavigationTemplate requires an ActionStrip): use a single no-op action instead of the zoom buttons (zoom works via pinch gestures).
Fix 100% crash: restore the NavigationTemplate ActionStrip — androidx.car.app 1.7 requires it (build() throws IllegalStateException without it).

Switch projection target to the standard PetalMapsActivity (forced sensorLandscape via manifest patch), drop the ActionStrip (map fills the car screen, pinch to zoom), and DiLink-style car mode: SCREEN_BRIGHT wakelock + lockscreen off + physical panel power-off (projection keeps rendering, zero panel battery drain).

Fix drag and small centered window: launch with --windowingMode fullscreen (drops stale task bounds), and scroll/fling gestures now anchor at the live window center instead of the last click position.

Fix inverted input and letterboxed portrait layout: AutoPetalMapsActivity screenOrientation now 'unspecified' (follows the car display, no artificial rotation/letterbox); touch dispatch applies window offset + inverse rotation via Matrix (all pointers).

Fix input dying after seconds and letterboxed layout: debounce VirtualDisplay recreation (700ms, host sends a burst of area changes), drop MULTIPLE_TASK (single task reuse), finish the old activity before destroying its display, and only dispatch touch to the live activity instance on the current display.

## What's new

- **AMOLED black theme.** New optional **AMOLED black theme** patch turns the whole dark appearance true black (`#000000`) — window, toolbars, tabs, nav drawer, cards, dialogs and backgrounds — so OLED/AMOLED screens switch those pixels off and battery life improves. The light appearance is untouched.
- **Rebranding is now on by default.** The recommended **Rebranding** patch renames the install/launcher package to `app.catsmoker.anime.witcher`, moves every `com.anime.witcher.*` permission under it and badges the icon with a red + — so the mod installs and runs even when the original app is still installed (fixes `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION` / `INSTALL_FAILED_CONFLICTING_PROVIDER`).
- **Configurable Telegram handle & About credit.** The `Rebranding: Telegram & About` sub-patch now exposes `telegram handle` and `about credit` options, so the support links and the About-screen credit line are fully customizable.
- **Faster, more reliable D-pad fix.** The Android TV support patch wires `TvFocusHelper` as an Activity lifecycle callbacks object, applies the focusability pass to every activity and every dialog the app shows, and only consumes a top-bar D-pad press once focus actually moved into a content row — so in-content D-pad navigation is left untouched.
- Website metadata on the patch source points to the original app page.

### ✨ New Features

* **RP Hypertrophy:** Add `Enable Premium` patch ([d67e7a9](https://github.com/braiNtropy/braintropy-patches/commit/d67e7a9cb4479f5e041dcd71367864a99fedbbdb))

**The Tracearr patches are now universal patches.**

I originally wrote "Unlock Premium" and "Disable Expo OTA updates" for Tracearr specifically, not realizing existing universal patches (e.g. [hoo-dles' Pairip patch](https://github.com/hoo-dles/morphe-patches)) would've gotten me close. The mechanisms were never Tracearr-specific: Pairip's license classes are injected unobfuscated by Google into every protected app, and the expo-updates toggle applies to any Expo app, so both are now available for any app you patch:

- **"Unlock Premium" → "Disable Pairip license check"** (now also covers Pairip's trial-end path)
- **"Disable Expo OTA updates"** (unchanged behavior, any Expo app)

Bonus: unlike patches that fake a successful response, this one no-ops the check entirely, so it works on degoogled devices with no Play Store or microG needed.

Both are now **off by default**, enable them per app in Morphe. If you had "Unlock Premium" enabled for Tracearr, re-enable it under its new name.

## Why was the MyoAdapt patch removed?

MyoAdapt's core feature, its adaptive training engine, which plans your next workout based on your completed sessions, runs entirely on MyoAdapt's servers and is fed only by server-side workout history. For accounts without an active subscription, the server hard-blocks (HTTP 402) every action that records or updates a workout.

A client-side patch can fake the workout flow (start, log, finish a session), but the server never learns about any of it: no history, no stats, and the proposed next workout never changes. The patch could therefore never deliver the one thing MyoAdapt is actually worth using for. So rather than shipping something that promises premium but can't deliver it, it has been removed.

JioHotstar account-flag fix. The re-signed build was sending IsTampered=true in the device-attestation blob (Kg/b) it posts to the server, which locked the account 24h for "suspicious activity" (error NM-4290). Adds "Spoof device attestation": forces all 8 attestation security flags (IsEmulator/IsRooted/IsTampered/IsProxy/isVpnActive/isSuspiciousFileExists/isPortsOpen/isDebuggerEnabled) to false at the blob constructor, so the app reports a clean device. WARNING: this only removes a client-sent signal — the server still sees the VPN exit IP and an already-flagged account stays on Hotstars radar. Do NOT run on an account you cannot afford to lose; test on a throwaway Jio number first. Other apps unchanged.

Adds three native Android TV OTT apps (all clean re-sign, no anti-tamper). JioHotstar (in.startv.hotstar 26.06.22.3): novel VPN/proxy-block bypass (device-confirmed India VPN + playback), remove ads, integrity spoof, analytics off, AD_ID, premium UI, screenshots/mirroring/4K/HDR, change name. Vi Movies and TV (com.vimtv 10.8): remove ads, analytics off, AD_ID, change name, premium UI. JioTV+ (com.jio.media.jiotvplus 2.6.4_2076): remove ads (JioAds + player VMAP), analytics off, AD_ID, change name. Existing apps unchanged (SonyLIV, Nutrilio, Threads, Arrow Puzzle, CrazyGames). Ads/premium are client-side; real content stays server-entitlement + Widevine gated. JioHotstar ad/premium/UX hooks adapted from Paresh-Maheshwari (GPL-3.0).

CrazyGames interstitial fix. Mid-game interstitial ads drove the same loading-overlay state machine as rewarded ads: the web waits for the interstitial Showed and Dismissed lifecycle events to dismiss the overlay. showInterstitial only resolved the call (firing neither event), so it hung. Interstitial events are named differently from rewarded (interstitialAdShowed/interstitialAdDismissed vs onRewarded*); the extension is generalized to fireAdEvents and now fires Showed+Dismissed for interstitial and Reward+Dismissed for rewarded. Other patches unchanged: Bypass Play license check, Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Change app name.

CrazyGames rewarded-ad fix. The auto-reward was firing only the Reward listener event, but the web finishes the rewarded flow (credits the reward and dismisses the loading overlay) on the Dismissed event, gated on Reward having fired first. So it stuck on the loading screen. Now fires Reward then Dismissed (in order) for both showRewardVideoAd and showRewardInterstitialAd, then resolves the call. Other patches unchanged: Bypass Play license check, Remove ads, Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Change app name.

## Move to MicroG-RE-BYD

MicroG-RE-BYD is now the only supported provider for gmaps-patches. Please migrate from ReVanced GmsCore or upstream MicroG-RE to the [latest MicroG-RE-BYD release](https://github.com/fangkampanat/MicroG-RE-BYD/releases/latest).

We have focused the provider improvements on BYD head units: corrected location identity handling, Maps location-setting compatibility, and auth package/signature handling. The Maps patch retains BYD navigation audio routing and selects the location service action exposed by the provider.

## Compatibility and testing

- Google Maps targets: `26.36.05.973607363` and `26.35.04.969485213`. Both passed patching and static verification with the final 1.1.0 bundle.
- Tested provider: MicroG-RE-BYD `7.1.1-byd.5`, ARM64 with a launcher icon.
- BYD Dolphin head unit: Maps navigation and use after vehicle restart passed user testing with the preceding 1.0.13 bundle and Maps 26.36.05.
- Android phone with official Google Play services: the final 1.1.0 APK passed user testing for account access, online maps, real-GPS navigation with numeric ETA/distance, and normal use. Installation over the previous version preserved app data; installed hash and launch checks passed.
- Existing Morphe-patched YouTube Music and YouTube apps are reported by the user to work normally with this provider. gmaps-patches continues to patch Google Maps only.

## Changes

- Rename the patch to **Google Maps for MicroG-RE-BYD** and update provider setup/migration instructions.
- Send the missing-provider download action to the MicroG-RE-BYD release page.
- Keep package `app.revanced.android.gms` for compatibility with existing Morphe apps.
- Remove redundant Maps string-routing code while preserving its output.
- Preserve existing auth routing, BYD navigation audio, permission rewrites, notification suppression and the original picture-in-picture declaration.

## Migration

Different provider signing keys may prevent update-over-install from ReVanced or upstream RE. If removal is required, the old provider's accounts/settings are cleared and need to be configured again. Do not remove official Google Play services. Use the signed ARM64 APK from MicroG-RE-BYD releases and follow its BYD background-operation setup guide.

You do not need to repatch compatible existing Morphe YouTube/YouTube Music APKs solely to switch providers. Reopen each app and check sign-in and playback after setup.

## Known limitations

One microG account-capability lookup logged `UNREGISTERED_ON_API_CONSOLE` during phone testing. This was the provider's account-state lookup, not an observed Maps sign-in or navigation failure. No `INVALID_APPID`, crash, ANR or SecurityException was found in the inspected app/provider logs. Timeline recording and backup have not been tested.

This release distributes the Maps `.mpp` bundle, not Google Maps APKs. Earlier public releases retain their recorded requirements and hashes.

### THE REAL FIX

Patch CustomerInfo.getActiveSubscriptions() to return a non-empty set.

**Root cause:** The JS app checks `activeSubscriptions.length > 0` FIRST in `hasActiveEntitlementOrSubscription()`. If the user never subscribed, RevenueCat returns an empty set. Our `EntitlementInfo.isActive()` patch was useless because there were ZERO `EntitlementInfo` objects to call it on.

**Fix:** `CustomerInfo.getActiveSubscriptions()` now returns `Collections.singleton("premium")` so JS sees an active subscription and calls `setIsPremiumUser(true)`.

### Fixes

- Add Superwall subscription status bypass to Morolingo Premium.
- Force Superwall Entitlements.setSubscriptionStatus to ACTIVE with a synthetic entitlement.
- Keep existing Pairip and RevenueCat patches.

**Note:** If your Morphe app still shows v1.19.0, clear the app cache and refresh the patch source.

### ✨ New Features

* **hillclimb:** instrument every rewarded ad entry point with a patch liveness beacon ([40efacc](https://github.com/legendsciber/morphe-patches/commit/40efacce3534f028ea0aec403141cfd1f8b17813))

### Fixed
- The Nuvio button now opens Nuvio in its own entry in the app switcher, instead of appearing merged into Letterboxd's task.

### Changed
- Refactored the Stremio/Nuvio launch code to share one helper for targeting a package, giving it its own task, and falling back to the web player, instead of repeating that logic three times.
- Simplified the internal app-selection logic from a three-state enum down to a boolean, since the third state was never actually treated differently anywhere. No user-facing behavior change beyond the task-switcher fix above.

### Changed
- **Add Stremio button** now works correctly with [Nuvio](https://github.com/tapframe/NuvioStreaming), a Stremio-addon client that also registers the stremio:// scheme but doesn't understand its URL shape. Previously, tapping the button just opened Nuvio's home screen instead of the film.
- The button now checks which of Nuvio or Stremio is installed and sends each its own correct deep link. Nuvio is preferred when both are present.
- The label and color switch to match: purple "Stremio", or blue "Nuvio" (using the blue from Nuvio's logo).

### Changed
- **Hide Video Store** now also hides the "Letterboxd Video Store" row in
  the search page's "Browse by" list, alongside the film-page banner and
  home-feed carousel row it already hid. No new patch — this extends the
  existing one, so no change needed in Morphe Manager beyond updating.

### Added
- **Hide Spotlight Ad** — hides the sponsored "Spotlight" ad card on the home
  feed (the "AD"-badged card next to "Popular this week"). On by default,
  toggleable independently of the other three patches.

### Changed
- README now recommends pairing this repo with
  [De-Vanced](https://github.com/RookieEnough/De-Vanced) for Letterboxd's
  AdMob banner/interstitial ads and the locked alternate app icons, which
  this repo doesn't touch.

Stremio button polish: press-ripple color now matches the trailer button, the pill shape is exact from the first drawn frame, and the button is hidden on films with no IMDb link (mirroring the trailer button when there's no trailer).
Maintenance release: more robust Stremio app launch with web fallback (no longer relies on package-visibility rules) and updated patch source description. No changes to patch behavior.
Adds the Hide Where to Watch patch: hides the "Where to watch" streaming-service icon row on film pages. Toggleable independently of the other patches.

Adds the Hide Video Store patch: hides the "Rent from Letterboxd Video Store" banner on film pages, and now also hides the video store carousel row on the home feed. Toggleable independently of the Stremio button patch.
Minor fix release for the Stremio button patch.
First fully-working release of the Stremio button patch (adds a purple Stremio button to Letterboxd film pages).

First beta targeting NuvioTV 0.9.0-beta only, with all seven Morphe patches.

- Port native settings, Storage, playback, download and subtitle hooks to 0.9.0-beta.
- Fix local MP4 playback, Storage grid crashes, fresh-entry download actions and imported subtitle identity.
- Translate Morphe settings into Spanish, Italian, German, French, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese; keep the Morphe title in every locale.
- Validation: 304 automated tests, 28 isolated patch/ABI combinations, seven TV emulator profiles and 30 final-build cold launches. Exact staged coverage and limits are documented in testing/VALIDATION_0.9.0-beta.md.

This is a prerelease for physical-TV acceptance. ARM hardware, physical USB/FAT32 files over 4 GB and long-duration soak testing remain outstanding. Only patch bundles and metadata are distributed; obtain the official NuvioTV APK separately.

Public-release validation passed in Morphe Manager 1.27.0: GitHub-source discovery, seven-patch enumeration, and successful all-seven patch application/signing. The exact downloaded .mpp SHA-256 is `01e7f80706faff8cc31dfe5bdf2bcce777300f1842e24d304c332f0609837790`.

## Pepper PL 8.13.02 prebuilt variants

Maintenance release: **patches and `.mpp` bundle are byte-equivalent to v1.0.0** — the only change is a fresh set of four prebuilt XAPKs targeting Pepper PL **8.13.02** (versionCode 81302) instead of 8.13.00.

If you build through Morphe Manager / `morphe-cli` you can keep using v1.0.0's bundle — there is no patch delta. The new release exists so that anyone grabbing a ready XAPK doesn't have to start from the old 8.13.00 base.

> 📦 **Also on ReVanced** → [pepper-revanced-patches v1.4.1](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches/releases/tag/v1.4.1) — same patch set, upstream [ReVanced Patcher](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patcher) bundle for [ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager).

### What changed in Pepper 8.13.02 (upstream)

### What's new

#### Patch #7 — Compact deal cards (opt-in)
Resource-only patch that shrinks the redesigned 8.x deal-list cards and their
loading skeletons toward the denser pre-redesign density. Targeted XML edits
to `item_deal_thread_card.xml`, `item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and
`item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`.

Per-element changes (real card):

| Element | Original | After patch | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thread_image` | 108×108dp, marginTop=8 | **92×92dp**, marginTop=4, marginBottom=8 | smaller thumbnail with a guaranteed 8 dp gap above the comment row |
| `deal_thread_button_vote_*` | 36×36dp | **32×32dp** | thinner up/down vote pills |
| `deal_thread_text_temperature` | `Subtitle2` + minHeight 36 + body2 autosize | **`CaptionBold`** + minHeight 32 + caption autosize | 2-3 digit temperature fits the new 92 dp temperature box |
| `top_barrier barrierMargin` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | tighter gap below the optional sponsored header |
| `thread_text_title` | maxLines=4, marginTop=8, vertical_bias=0.5 | **maxLines=2**, marginTop=4, vertical_bias=0.25 | title clamps to 2 lines and hugs the top of its space |
| `thread_text_username marginBottom` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | less padding above the get-deal button |
| `thread_button_comment_count` | 48×48 dp, Start=parent | **32×32 dp**, Start=guideline_start | smaller comment button that respects the card's left guideline |
| `comment_count` | maxWidth=38, marginStart=38, Start=button | **maxWidth=42, gravity=center_vertical, height=32, Start_toEndOf=button** | comment count number renders **next to** the button instead of overlapping it via the original `marginStart=38dp` hack |
| `deal_thread_button_get_deal*` (×3) | wrap_content + Material default insets | **minHeight=40dp + insetTop=0 + insetBottom=0** + Baseline_toBaselineOf removed | the Material3 Button.Icon style ships with `insetTop=6dp`/`insetBottom=6dp` defaults — on a 40 dp View that leaves only 28 dp of orange button area, which clipped the Subtitle2 text. Zeroing the insets restores the full 40 dp visible area. |

Skeleton (`item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and `item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`):
- `placeholder_temperature_box` 108×36 → **92×32**
- `placeholder_image` 108×108 → **92×92**
- `placeholder_text_title` height 52 → **24** (single bar instead of two-line block)
- `placeholder_date / merchant / username` width 104 → **80**
- `placeholder_button_get_deal` height stays at 40 but margins drop 8 → **4**
- `placeholder_comment_and_share` 64×24 → **48×32** (matches the real comment button's 32 dp height)
- sponsored-only: `thread_header_text minHeight` 32 → **24** (smaller "SPONSORED" header bar)

All placeholder dimensions now match the real card 1:1, so the loading skeleton
snaps to the final layout instead of jumping when data arrives.

The patch is **opt-in** (`default = false`) — it only runs when you tick it in
Morphe Manager, or pass `-e "Compact deal cards"` to the CLI.

## SoundCloud

- Fix the login crash reported in [#2](https://github.com/V4n1X/morphe-patches/issues/2): `VerifyError: branch offset of zero not allowed`. The Go+ patch now uses valid branch targets and preserves the `Feature` constructor's registers.
- Add **experimental** support for `2026.09.23-release` across all five SoundCloud patches. `2026.08.26-release` remains supported.

## Parcello

- Add the **Disable ads** patch for Parcello `2.2.20` (Android 8.0+), removing AdMob ads, advertising consent prompts and sponsored/promotional banners.
- Preserve package tracking, barcode scanning, notifications and purchase entitlements.
- Parcello support is **experimental**.

## Updating

Refresh this patch source in Morphe Manager and re-patch an **original, unmodified APK/APKM** using the v1.4.0 bundle. Existing patched installations do not receive the SoundCloud fix automatically.

## Validation

Automated regression checks and local patching/DEX checks passed for both supported SoundCloud versions. All five patches together also passed resource and DEX output checks on `2026.09.23-release`. Parcello passed local patching, resource/DEX compilation and JavaScript behavior checks.

On-device validation is still pending. Parcello `2.2.20` and SoundCloud `2026.09.23-release` remain marked as experimental.

## 1.3.0-dev.2

## Manager Patcher 1.15.1 compatibility fix

Fixes the reported `NoSuchMethodError: TikTokFingerprint.getAccessFlags()` while applying Feed filter with Manager 1.34.1-dev.1 / Patcher 1.15.1. Selector evidence now reads the declared access-flag mask from a getter owned by this bundle. Exact access-flag matching, missing/ambiguous hook failures, APK hash verification and native mutation contracts remain active.

The failure was reproduced using the published 1.3.0-dev.1 bundle and the actual Patcher 1.15.1 binary. The corrected CI bundle and published 1.3.0-dev.2 both pass the same selector-resolution probe. Android DEX also contains the corrected call and defines its target getter.

[Manager runtime CI](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/actions/runs/37424982193) passes 37/37 patches and APK rebuilding for global 46.7.3 and the pinned 47.1.3 APK using Patcher 1.15.1 (hash-pinned Desktop 1.18.1). All 128 Kotlin/Android tests and 17 Python tests pass. All 11 stored original baseline contract fields are preserved (165 methods, 104 classes). These catalog tests cover this bundle's 37 TikTok patches; additional patches from another source and device behavior require separate testing.

## TikTok 47.1.3 device test

Update the BlueIT source in Morphe to **1.3.0-dev.2**, or import [patches-1.3.0-dev.2.mpp](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/releases/download/v1.3.0-dev.2/patches-1.3.0-dev.2.mpp). Retry patching the [pinned global TikTok 47.1.3 APK](https://d.apkpure.net/b/APK/com.zhiliaoapp.musically?versionCode=2024701030), package `com.zhiliaoapp.musically`, versionCode `2024701030`, original SHA-256 `8b5569f592a5534652ae460ef1d9e7f7394b5b7fdde44ae64f106d76767e2622`.

47.1.3 passes this dev bundle without force or an experimental environment opt-in. Device regression testing remains pending; the candidate is unqualified and excluded from stable-channel builds.

Published MPP: 2,221,821 bytes, SHA-256 `78f0930b780d32036b3257599110b626a5e75a182c6f6e777b66bd053014f516`. All 497 class, DEX, extension and contract entries match the CI-tested bundle byte-for-byte. The manifest, asset and Morphe metadata all report 1.3.0-dev.2. Main and stable remain unchanged.

[Release workflow](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/actions/runs/37425811498). Tested fix commit: `38facb42dec2073c5a759a21491a415db09ba8a4`.

[Complete baseline acceptance](https://github.com/BlueDragon4251/tiktok-patches-for-morphe/actions/runs/37424985946) also passes final DEX discovery and baseline self-comparison on the exact fix commit.

## 1.0.0-dev.1 (2026-08-20)

### ✨ New Features

* Add Reclub unlock premium patch ([37a88e2](https://github.com/drnhzn/supreme-patches/commit/37a88e24c396fba11a4ded9572897a7955a8da9d))

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed manifest wrapping that prevented Morphe Manager from loading the v1.26.0 bundle. The Description field exceeded the 72-byte manifest line limit and wrapped, which Morphe could not parse. Shortened the description so the manifest stays on one line. Patch content is identical to v1.26.0 — supports MovieBox 4.0.03.0918.03.

### Features

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** support for the latest MovieBox version 4.0.03.0918.03 (versionCode 50020129). The latest release changed its obfuscation scheme, so the patch now locates target methods by the string constants they load and the methods they invoke instead of relying on unstable single-letter method names. Existing custom features (Telegram channel popup, floating support button, download routing) are preserved unchanged.

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** restored the download URL routing to the previously working behavior and fixed the floating coffee button visibility (it now appears on regular screens, never on the player); Telegram popup daily limit unchanged

### New Features

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** promo cadence rules

## What changed

### New Features
- **MovieBox - All-In-One:** redesigned promo surfaces - paper & ink theme

The Telegram card now opens like a handwritten note: off-white paper background, ink-black serif headline ("Hey, I'm dhrubo."), letter-spaced kicker, soft body copy, the @dhrubo_moira_geche handle on a pill, a solid black *Join the channel* button and an italic *maybe later* link.

The coffee button is now a floating off-white pill pinned to the bottom-right of every screen, with a small coffee-cup illustration and the label **"Buy me a cup of coffee"** - tapping it opens supportkori.com/dhrubomorse.

Popup trigger logic, download fixes and every other patch are unchanged.

## What changed

### New Features
- **MovieBox - All-In-One:** Telegram popup on every launch and floating coffee button

### Bug Fixes
- **MovieBox - All-In-One:** serve downloads as progressive MP4 through the DASH proxy

Signed streams had every URL field rewritten to the DASH manifest, so the downloader fetched index.mpd (a tiny XML) or hit a 403 once cookies were missing — downloads broke while playback kept working. `downloadUrl`, `resourceLink` and `sourceUrl` now receive a local progressive MP4 URL served with cookie handling and Range support, movie titles without se/ep are routed too, and the connection pool gained headroom for parallel download tasks.

  bundles) with skip-or-fail reasoning. Proven: discovery reproduces
  every v1.4.0 site exactly on all five known bundles, CLI bytes
  identical. (stable)

  grew eligibility hooks and a CreateFunctionEnvironment in its head
  (fn 62203, own 17-byte anchor; same 6-byte return-null edit over
  GPE + CFE); gift-bar flag in ChatInputRightActions (fn 56000, own

Keeps the Hermes patches alive: pins the app to its built-in bundle.

Without it, an OTA silently undoes all Hermes patches (observed on device: banner returned, composer gift never left). Smali edit to DCDReactNativeHost.getJSBundleFile(), verified by re-decode.

- Verified: official Morphe CLI applies the bundle to all three stable APKs (Hermes edits exact, no strays); classes.dex confirmed present.

## Detailed changes

## NuvioTV features

- Add **Upcoming movie dates in library and collections** for beta.4 and beta.5.
  Two independent, disabled-by-default switches under **UI** show blue `dd-MMM-yy`
  badges on unreleased movie posters. Exact poster metadata takes precedence;
  missing dates use a bounded background catalog lookup with a six-hour cache.
  Released movies and unknown dates have no badge. A past release year skips
  unnecessary lookups; current/future years still require an exact date.
- Add **Preload streams in Continue Watching** for playable movie/episode cards.
- Add **Preload streams on detail page** for the current Play or Resume target,
  following changes to the next episode. Both **Streams** switches are independent
  and disabled by default. They reuse Nuvio's native source search, installed
  addons/plugins, cache expiration, profile checks, and playback pause controls.
  Background work is bounded, and playback starts only when Play is pressed.
- Group the Santodan-Patches menu under **Continue Watching**, **UI**, and **Streams**
  using native, non-focusable labels. Groups with no installed patches are omitted.

## Compatibility and improvements

- Support NuvioTV **1.1.0-beta.5** across all existing patches. Movie dates, finale
  dates, airing series, and stream preloading support beta.4/beta.5. Merged progress,
  remaining episodes, and side-by-side installation also support beta.2.
- Reduce remaining-episode badge work by counting recently displayed cards in the
  background, limiting catalog fallback work, and stopping new work when disabled.
- Isolate badge Compose groups to preserve the host's remembered state. Movie and
  series date badges can be selected independently or together.
- Add stream diagnostics for preload starts, elapsed time, source counts, and
  timeout/cancellation outcomes. Repeated composition hits stay silent; stream
  URLs are omitted and custom video IDs are redacted.
- Movie-date toggle diagnostics identify **library** or **collections**. Routine
  settings-render logs are suppressed.

## Diagnostics and validation

- Add `"SantodanStreams:V"` and `"SantodanMovieRelease:V"` to logcat filters.
- Movie dates use native release-time rules: date-only releases use UTC midnight,
  zoned timestamps use their exact instant, and timestamp badges show the local date.
  Release metadata does not guarantee an available streaming source.
- Local checks cover date parsing, release boundaries, timezone handling,
  independent settings, nested/restart card scopes, and all 128 menu selections.
  Original beta.4/beta.5 DEX checks verify coexistence with the existing patches.
  Real beta.5 APK application and final DEX verification cover the movie patch on
  its own and with all Nuvio patches. Device logs confirm working date lookups and
  successful stream preloads without badge-rendering errors.

Hushfeed v0.61.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`).

A large release. TikTok 47.1.3 is supported alongside 47.0.3, and every fix made since 0.60.0 is in it.

* TikTok 47.1.3 works (#33). Every patch applies to both versions, and Morphe Manager lists both.
* Save media on a comment sticker reads TikTok's own sticker data, so it keeps working from one TikTok version to the next. The button also lightens while you hold it, like TikTok's Share and Save beside it.
* Copy comments without username works from the comment sheet's own menu again.
* On a foldable with the split comment view, folding or unfolding no longer jumps to another video when Hide seen videos is on (#26).
* Camera and microphone indicator shows on TikTok's camera screen, with a green square for the camera and an orange diamond for the microphone.
* Hide Play Store update offer is a new optional patch.
* After an update, a What's new row at the top of Hushfeed's settings opens the changelog. The settings screens had a long polish pass too.

The changelog has the full list.

## Checked

* The full test gate (2,076 runtime tests, the patch tests and both Android lint checks) passed on the commit before this release. The one change after it, the Save media press, passed its own tests.
* All 96 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and to 47.1.3 with this exact bundle, with no manifest changes. The release receipt attached here has each version's verdicts. Use 47.0.3 or 47.1.3 when patching.
* This exact bundle was installed on a Galaxy S25 running TikTok 47.1.3, and TikTok started with no crash. On the same phone, the build just before it saved an animated comment sticker through Save media, and Hook status found all 34 areas with nothing missing.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source in Manager to update. Keep the manager's existing signing key.

Hushfeed v0.60.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`).

A small release with three fixes.

* Comments that wouldn't send now go out. TikTok checks each comment against the page you opened most recently, and when that page had already lost its screen, TikTok dropped the comment without a word and left the text in the box. Comment send fix, a new patch that's on by default, checks it against the comment panel instead.
* With Caption above comments on, the caption no longer shows over the video too. Hide the caption still hides it on its own.
* Allow Duet and Stitch now covers creators who limit duets and stitches on their whole account, not just on one video.

## Checked

* 2,040 runtime tests and the patch tests passed, along with both Android lint checks.
* All 94 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3. Use 47.0.3 when patching.
* On a Galaxy S22 running TikTok 47.0.3, comments from the feed went out. With the state that stopped them forced on, TikTok alone stopped the send at the same point the report showed, and the fix sent it.

This is the biggest release so far. It carries everything built since 0.58.0 and the fixes for this week's bug reports.

**From the tracker**

* The seek bar is back for everyone. TikTok runs an experiment that hides it on every video except paid content, which is why it was missing from the feed but still there in the drama player. Show the progress bar now overrides that experiment, and a second one that hid the bar on videos TikTok hadn't marked as draggable. (#16)
* Watch history and Activity center work with the in-app browser guard on. The guard now protects outside websites and leaves TikTok's own pages alone. (#16)
* Hide the tab names above the feed, a new switch on the Feed tabs page, takes the Following and For You names off the top of the feed. Swiping between the feeds still works and the search button stays. (#32)
* Fill the screen with the video, a new switch under Playback, crops a video until it covers the whole screen. It's for phones where TikTok leaves a black strip under a 9:16 video. Fit the video to the screen does the opposite, and turning either one on turns the other off. (#29)
* Taking the LIVE tab off the bottom bar no longer hides TikTok's LIVE button at the top of the feed too. In regions where TikTok puts LIVE in the bottom bar it hides the corner button, and it kept doing that after Filter bottom tabs removed the tab, which left no way into LIVE from the feed. (#28)
* Split comment view on a folding phone now follows the fold while TikTok is open. (#26)
* Hide TikTok Shop in search, a new switch under Feed filter, takes the Products block out of search results. AMOLED dark theme works on an .apkm in Morphe Manager again. (#21)

**New switches and patches**

* Pause Hushfeed sits at the top of the settings. From the next start TikTok runs as if it weren't patched, so you can tell whether something is Hushfeed's doing without turning switches off one at a time.
* Wait a day to loosen the budget is new on the Screen time page. A change that tightens the budget applies at once, and one that loosens it waits for the next day. Keep a paused video paused and Leave when TikTok says time is up are new there too.
* More opens the comments and Caption above comments put the whole caption at the top of the comments. Show poll results before voting draws a comment poll's bars before you pick an answer.
* Under Feed screen, a long press on Comment, Share or Favorites can play the video at the hold speed, and the Long press row can find the sound on YouTube Music. The new Swipe-left controls patch decides what a left swipe does, and Hide the Tako bubble now covers the search results page too.
* On Feed tabs, Open TikTok on picks the tab TikTok starts on. Keep For You on a Home tap and Keep For You on a pull down stop the feed reloading under you, Show TikTok's feed buttons puts TikTok's own play, previous and next buttons on the feed, and Hide the unread badges takes the red counts off the bottom tabs.
* Feed filter adds Hide mini dramas, and Creator exceptions for accounts whose videos should stay whatever the preference filters say.
* Playback adds Speed while you hold the video and Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button.
* A save of three or more files shows a running count with a Cancel button, and a finished save offers a way to the file. Live photos saved from comments keep their motion.
* The new Network request report patch is off by default. Disable telemetry now stops the analytics uploads themselves, and Remove ads reaches the full-screen ad TikTok can open with.

**Fixes on TikTok 47.0.3**

AMOLED dark theme paints the right colors again and blackens the sheets and panels too. Video download quality and Save the original photos work, the daily hold pauses the video, and the two pause switches work. Hide comment popup ads stops the animation itself. The comment keyword filter reaches translated comments, a bigger caption size no longer splits words, and Hushfeed's settings survive TikTok's crash recovery.

- Suppression des contrôles locaux de proximité pour ouvrir les véloparcs (500 m) et déverrouiller les vélos (100 m). Un compte, la localisation et un accès valide au service restent nécessaires.
- Présélection des quatre patchs Naolib dans Morphe.

### 🐛 Corrections

- Maintien des parkings déjà chargés lorsque leur actualisation renvoie une liste vide, grâce au patch « Conserver les parkings ».
- Correction du démarrage de l’application modifiée et du plantage introduit par l’intégration de la carte.
- Interception de l’ouverture directe des détails d’un parking pour afficher d’abord sa fenêtre d’information.
- Utilisation des dernières données reçues pour les favoris ; la disponibilité est indiquée comme non actualisée lorsqu’aucune donnée récente n’est chargée.

### 📝 Textes et nettoyage

- Noms et descriptions des patchs Naolib, Keepcool et Leboncoin en français.
- Suppression des anciens patchs expérimentaux liés à la signature et à la carte.
- Documentation d’installation et d’utilisation de Naolib mise à jour.

Le patch de carte nécessite [Morphe microG](https://morphe.software/microg) avec son moteur de carte ; la version 7.2.1 est compatible. Les services Google Play doivent rester installés. Le chargement d’une nouvelle zone de carte dépend toujours du réseau et du moteur de carte.

# [1.0.0](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/De-Vanced/releases/tag/v1.0.0) (2026-09-13)

Welcome to the inaugural standalone release of **De-Vanced (Morphe Patches)**! This release consolidates months of advanced research and engineering into a unified, out-of-the-box experience for Google Photos on both rooted and non-rooted devices (including Samsung Galaxy S24, Pixel, OnePlus, Xiaomi, and more).

---

### ✨ Core Highlights & Features

#### 🧠 Neural Model Auto-Seeder & Background Streaming (`PhotosModelSeeder`)
- **Seamless Non-Root Delivery**: Automatically provisions all official TensorFlow Lite ML models required for Google Photos AI editing tools.
- **Moods & Creative Lab Expansion**: Bundled complete 20-asset neural suite (Vision Transformer ToneFix model `vit_tonefix_v2.tflite`, 10 3D LUT profiles, 5 film textures, and 2 light leak overlays) bringing the total bundle to 72 verified models (~336.8 MB) with automated MDD group registration.
- **In-App Background Downloader**: On fresh installs (such as on Samsung Galaxy S24), streams and unzips the verified model pack directly from GitHub Releases CDN with zero user intervention.
- **Clear-Data Immunity**: Simultaneously caches all models and MDD manifests into persistent external storage (`/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/app.morphe.android.apps.photos/`), ensuring models instantly rehydrate after "Clear Data" without needing network access.
- **Model Readiness Smali Gates**: Hard-baked bytecode overrides for `Lanqb`, `Lanrk`, `Laspz`, and `Larea` to report Magic Eraser, Portrait Segmenter, and Sky replacement models as loaded and ready.

#### ☁️ Unlimited Original Quality Backup (Pixel 2016 Spoof)
- **Permanent Unmetered Cloud Storage**: Default feature spoofing set to original Google Pixel (`NEXUS_PRELOAD`) for unlimited photo and video backups at full original quality.
- **Tensor TPU Crash Prevention**: Selectively avoids newer Pixel 8/9 spoof flags (`PIXEL_2023_MIDYEAR_PRELOAD`) that trigger missing `.darwinn` Tensor NPU hardware traps on Qualcomm Snapdragon and Samsung Exynos chipsets.

#### 🎛️ Complete Official Phenotype Flags Engine (2,492 Flags)
- **Zero-Config Feature Parity**: Embeds the full set of 2,492 production phenotype flags (`PhenotypeSeedData.java`), automatically seeded into SharedPreferences on first boot.
- **In-App Phenotype Flag Manager**: Access and customize experimental Google Photos flags directly from the app toolbar with built-in search, toggle overrides, and JSON import/export.
- **Dynamic Google Account Synchronization**: Automatically links the active Google account token across multi-account environments to preserve individual settings.

#### 👤 Dynamic Google Account Avatar Bridge
- **Native Account Switcher Support**: Fetches and renders user Google profile avatars dynamically in circular anti-aliased views across top app bars and account switcher sheets without requiring Google Play Services signature spoofing.

#### 🎨 Scrapbook Memories & Local Font Provider Bypass
- **Offline Font Resolution**: Hard-bakes a local font provider bypass (`BakeMemoryStyleFlagsPatch.kt`) pointing to system `/system/fonts/` (Roboto, Noto Serif), eliminating corrupted cutout text or crashes caused by missing GMS font certificates.
- **Memory Styles**: Fully unlocks modern scrapbooking styles, animated collage templates, and memory music playback.

---

### 📦 Compatibility
- **Target Application**: Google Photos (`com.google.android.apps.photos` / `app.morphe.android.apps.photos`)
- **Supported Versions**: `7.0.0` - `7.92.0+`
- **Supported Android Versions**: Android 8.0 (API 26) through Android 15 (API 35)
- **Supported Architectures**: `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`

### 1. All 13 Camera Looks Unlocked (3 New Looks Added)
In addition to the 10 original signature Looks, all **3 brand-new Pixel Camera 11.1 Looks** are now fully enabled and integrated directly into the carousel UI:
* **Flat** (`qvd` / *Pesto*): Low-contrast, high dynamic range flat color profile optimized for post-shot color grading.
* **Buffalo** (`qvg` / *Unflat*): Warm, punchy earth tones with balanced contrast and expanded dynamic latitude.

### 2. Viewfinder Dual Sliders & Universal Bidirectional Sync
* **Viewfinder Tap-to-Focus Sliders Restored:** Resolved the issue where the dual sliders were missing from the viewfinder. Sliders now reliably appear on tap-to-focus across all modes.
* **Full Dynamic Exposure Range:** Restored full range on both sliders:
  * **Brightness:** -4.0 to +4.0 stops.
  * **Shadow:** Linearized HDR+ shadow boost up to 15.3x.
* **Bidirectional Synchronization:** Viewfinder on-screen knobs and bottom sheet drawers now share the exact same underlying HAL observables—scrubbing either slider updates the other instantly in real time.
* **Camera2 HAL Preview Integration:** Decoupled `DualEvCtrl` from twilight flags (`ptm.g = false`), allowing real-time tone mapping previews directly in the viewfinder.

---

### 3. Pixel 10 & Pro 12MP Photo Saving Fix
* Fixed an issue on Pixel 10 / Tensor G5 hardware where 12MP captures failed to save or froze during post-processing.
* Disabled incompatible Tensor G5-exclusive pipelines (`camera.ceftazidime = 0` Flare Removal and `camera.use_eclipse = 0` Eclipse AE).
* Injected fallbacks for binned RAW stream dimensions (`tele_binned_raw_width` = 2016, `tele_binned_raw_height` = 1512, `binned_row_start` = 0) to ensure zero capture drops.

---

### 4. Complete Feature Matrix
* **Permanent Portrait Mode Fix:** Pure-TFLite monocular depth routing (`midasnet`, `portrait_matting_mask`) fixing front camera blur and rear camera bokeh drops.
* **Pro Manual Controls:** Unlocks Manual Focus, Shutter Speed, ISO, and Focus Peaking on all supported models.
* **10x Quick Zoom:** Discrete 10x viewfinder zoom toggle in Photo mode.
* **Creator Suite:** Teleprompter HUD (`biotite`), Live Audio VU Meter (`mica`), and Social Framing Guides (`slate`).
* **Non-Root App Clone:** Installable side-by-side with stock Pixel Camera (`com.google.android.GoogleCamera.morphe`).

# Pixel Camera Morphe Patch v1.0.3

## Release Overview

* **Patch Version:** `1.0.3`
* **Target App:** Pixel Camera (`com.google.android.GoogleCamera`)
* **Target App Version:** `11.0.073.972752740.32`
* **Version Code:** `69623294`
* **Bundle MD5:** `9b3a5b29d3344940f86b516a9a4c2835`
* **Release Artifact:** `patches-1.0.3.mpp`
* **Alternative Filename:** `morphe-patches-pixelcamera-1.0.3.mpp`

---

## Critical Fixes

### Pixel 10 and Pixel 10 Pro 1× Photo Saving

Fixed an issue where photos captured at **1× zoom** could fail to save to MediaStore or disappear after capture. Photos captured at 5× and 10× could occasionally save successfully.

### Root Cause

The GCAM HDR+ post-processing pipeline was aborting during `FinishShot` because of an unhandled exception:

```text
IllegalStateException:
Unable to open Flare Removal model asset file
(ceftazidime_*.uncompressed)
```

The missing asset was requested by the Pixel 10 / Pixel 10 Pro hardware profile when processing wide-lens captures.

### Fixes Applied

* Added a fail-safe return inside `mkm.j` to prevent `FinishShot` from being aborted by flare-removal processing.
* Updated the `ejn` device profiles for:

  * Pixel 10 (`Blake`)
  * Pixel 10 Pro (`Frankel`)
* Disabled:

  * `camera.ceftazidime_enabled`
  * `camera.decepticon_enabled`
* Cleared references to missing uncompressed assets.
* Added runtime overrides forcing the following flags to `false`:

  * `camera.ceftazidime`
  * `camera.decepticon`
  * `camera.use_eclipse`
* Added sensor stream fallbacks for binned RAW dimensions:

  * `0x7e0`
  * `0x5e8`
* Added protection against `NullPointerException` when telephoto stream pointers are unavailable.

---

## Included Features and Patches

### Pixel 11 Camera Looks

Backports all **10 Pixel 11 Camera Looks** to Pixel 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 series devices.

Includes:

* Original
* Natural
* Shadows
* Vanilla
* Editorial
* Velvet
* Classic
* Digi
* Black Tie
* Minimal

Features include real-time viewfinder rendering and post-capture HDR+ grain and tone-map processing.

### Portrait Mode Fix

Improves portrait capture reliability by routing portrait depth generation through Google's monocular depth TFLite pipeline.

Addresses:

* Front-camera excessive blur
* Rear-camera portraits without bokeh
* Portrait depth generation failures across supported cameras

### Viewfinder Quick Access Controls

Adds customizable quick-access controls to the camera viewfinder.

Features:

* Configurable left shortcut
* Configurable right shortcut
* 10-step intensity control
* Real-time adjustment of supported Camera Look parameters

### 10× Viewfinder Quick Zoom

Adds a dedicated **10× quick zoom button** to the Photo mode viewfinder.

### Pixel Camera Creator Suite

Adds the following creator-focused tools:

**Teleprompter HUD**

Biotite-based teleprompter interface for displaying scripts while recording video.

**Live Audio VU Meter**

Mica-based real-time microphone level visualization.

**Social Framing Guides**

Slate-based framing guides for:

* 9:16
* 1:1
* 4:5

### Pro Manual Controls

Enables additional manual controls on supported non-Pro Pixel devices:

* Manual focus
* Shutter speed
* ISO
* Focus peaking
* Live control badges

### Non-Root Clone Mode

Provides an optional clone package name:

```text
com.google.android.GoogleCamera.morphe
```

This allows the patched camera to be installed alongside the stock Pixel Camera without requiring root.

  * **Classic** — Timeless analog film aesthetic inspired by Kodak Portra.
  * **Digi** — Early-2000s compact digital camera punch and flare.
  * **Black Tie** — Fine-grain, high-contrast monochrome dynamic range.
  * **Minimal** — Clean, desaturated Scandinavian aesthetic.
* **Universal Tensor Engine**: Automatic fallback execution on Mali-G715 / Immortalis GPU and multi-threaded Halide CPU workers on Tensor G1–G4 devices without vendor HAL dependencies.

### 2. Viewfinder Quick Access Controls & Discrete Tick-Slider
* **Custom Viewfinder Shortcuts**: Assign Left and Right quick shortcuts directly in Camera Settings (`Settings → Fast access → Quick access controls`).
* **On-Screen Tick Slider**: Tap anywhere on the viewfinder to reveal the vertical 10-tick slider—scrub through all Looks seamlessly without diving into menus.
* **Haptic Feedback**: Tactile feedback on slider detents with persistent preference memory across app restarts.

### 3. 5x Optical Telephoto Portrait Mode & 10x Quick Zoom
* **True 5x Optical Telephoto Bokeh**: Unlocks physical periscope portrait captures (`RAW_TELE` + `PD_TELE`) on Pixel 7 Pro, 8 Pro, 9 Pro, and 10 Pro—breaking the 1.5x / 2.0x digital crop restriction.
* **Dedicated 10x Quick Zoom Viewfinder Button**: Instant 1-tap Super Res Zoom toggle on the viewfinder (`0.5x, 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x`) powered by Google's `NativeZoomPlus` and `NativeFusionZoom` pipelines.

### 4. Pixel Camera Creator Suite
* **Teleprompter HUD (`biotite`)**: Viewfinder script overlay with auto-scrolling, customizable WPM speed, and inline script editing.
* **Live Audio VU Meter (`mica`)**: Real-time microphone input volume indicator rendered over the viewfinder.
* **Social Framing Guides (`slate`)**: Quick grid overlays for 9:16 vertical video, 1:1 square, and standard ratios.

### 5. Dual Installation (Standalone Clone APK)
* Renamed package namespace to `com.google.android.GoogleCameraEng` allowing side-by-side installation with your stock Google Camera app.
* No root, Magisk, or Bootloader unlocking required.

### Gboard Enhancement Patches Suite v1.4.2

#### 🐛 Fixes in v1.4.2
- **Fix Glide Trail Custom Color Reflection:** Resolved an inverted branch condition (`if-gez` -> `if-ltz`) in `GestureOverlayView.morpheOnDrawHook` timing calculation which was prematurely returning and permanently blocking `morpheApplyCustomTrailSettings` from executing and applying the custom color during glide typing.
- **Synchronous Dual-Context Storage:** Upgraded preference saving in `GlideTrailPreferences` to synchronously `.commit()` values to both default and Device-Encrypted (DE) storage contexts so preferences are immediately visible across all Gboard processes.
- **Mutual Exclusivity:** Choosing a custom color in `ColorWheelDialog` automatically disables Rainbow RGB mode so your chosen color is immediately displayed without conflicting rainbow cycles.
- **View Lifecycle Hook:** Added an active hook on `GestureOverlayView.onSizeChanged` to proactively reload and apply custom settings whenever the keyboard view is displayed or resized.

#### ✨ Included Patches
- **Backspace Repeat Haptic Feedback**: Delivers continuous tactile pulses on each repeated character deletion when holding down the backspace key.
- **Enter Key Tasker Event**: Dispatches high-priority Android Intent broadcasts to Tasker on Enter/IME actions.
- **Glide Trail Customization**: Color Wheel picker, continuous duration/width/length sliders, and dynamic Rainbow RGB effect.

#### 📱 Add or Refresh in Morphe App
1. Open **Morphe** on your Android device.
2. Go to **Settings** -> **Sources** -> Refresh sources (or add `https://github.com/ausamnco/gboard-enc-patches`).
3. Repatch Gboard and enjoy!

### Gboard Enhancement Patches Suite v1.4.1

#### 🐛 Fixes & Improvements in v1.4.1:
- **Fixed Glide Typing Settings Crash**:
  - Removed unsupported \ which was causing crashes on inflation due to stripped layout resources in Gboard.
  - Eliminated broken bytecode references to obfuscated classes and non-existent superclass methods in \.
- **New Interactive Slider Dialogs**:
  - Integrated dedicated \ for continuous control of:
    - **Trail Fade Duration**: 200ms to 4000ms with live ms value display and quick preset chips.
    - **Trail Width & Thickness**: 2dp to 40dp with live dp value display and quick preset chips.
    - **Trail Length & Retention**: 5 to 100 points with live points display and quick preset chips.
- **Interactive HSV Color Wheel**:
  - In-app 360° hue sweep & radial saturation disc, brightness slider, hex preview swatch, and 8 quick preset chips.
- **Robust Central Preference Bridge**:
  - Taps and summaries are handled fail-safe through reflection-based \ without altering stock fragment class structure.

#### 📱 Add to Morphe App
1. Open **Morphe** on your phone.
2. Go to **Settings** -> **Sources** and pull down to refresh:
   
3. In **Patcher**, select Gboard, select your patches, and tap **Patch**!

### Gboard Enhancement Patches Suite v1.4.0

#### ✨ What's New in v1.4.0:
- **Interactive HSV Color Wheel**: Built-in Color Wheel dialog featuring 360° hue sweep, radial saturation disc, brightness slider, hex preview (#RRGGBB), 8 quick preset chips, and 'Reset to Theme'.
- **Continuous Control Sliders**: Smooth SeekBar sliders with live value display:
  - **Trail Fade Duration**: 200ms (fast) to 4000ms (lingering ribbon)
  - **Trail Width & Thickness**: 2dp (hairline) to 40dp (thick glow)
  - **Trail Length & Retention**: 5 (compact) to 100 (extended ribbon) points
- **Grouped Settings Layout**: Neatly grouped under a dedicated **'Glide Trail Customizations'** category directly under the stock **'Show gesture trail'** switch in *Settings -> Glide typing*.
- **Dynamic Real-Time Updates**: Adjustments update instantly during glide typing without needing to restart Gboard.

- **Preload article images** no longer takes the article view down on 3.8.5. It wrote to v0 at the top of two methods, and R8 compiles one of them with no local registers at all there, so v0 was the parameter holding `this`. The work moved into a method of its own, and the patches that still borrow a register now check there is one first.
- New patch **Remove ads**: no ad is requested anywhere, rather than requested and hidden. It covers the shared banner factory, the ad rows inside articles and the digest lists, the app's own fallback ad and the TAMedia banner it reaches for when it thinks AdMob is blocked, and the two ad SDKs it starts at launch.
- New patch **Patch settings**: a tab of its own in JPTT's settings. It is built out of what R8 left of the app's own copy of androidx.preference, which is less than the library has: the screen is attached to the hierarchy by hand, and each number opens a dialog of its own rather than an EditTextPreference, which is reopened by a key these preferences cannot be given. Every option these patches used to bake in at build time -- image cache size, preload limit and concurrency, both recent search counts -- is now editable there, with what was chosen in Morphe Manager as its default. It also exports every setting the app has to a JSON file and reads one back, which survives the reinstall a new signature forces. Accounts and passwords are in a different preferences file and are not touched.
- New patch **Reconnect on return**: coming back to the app reconnects straight away. The countdown JPTT shows grows to eight seconds, and `onStop()` cancels it without clearing it, so returning could leave you watching a countdown that was not running. This runs what tapping the disconnected banner already ran.
- New patch **Fix image links**: an imgur album or `.mp4`, an imgur address without the `i.` subdomain and a `meee.com.tw` page now show the picture instead of a broken preview or the host's own banner. It rewrites only the URL the preview and the full size viewer load; the article text keeps the link that was posted.
- JPTT 3.8.5 is now a declared target, and **Disable Play license check** works on it again. PairIP moved: 3.8.5 wraps the check in `LicenseClient.checkLicense()` and calls it from `Application.attachBaseContext()` as well as from the content provider, so stopping the provider is no longer enough -- the check still ran and put its dialog up mid-session. The patch now stops `LicenseClient.initializeLicenseCheck()`, where every route meets, and silences what a failed check does besides: the dialog, the paywall, the shutdown and the repeated re-check.
- **Fix article list loading** stays on for 3.8.5. The app fixed one of the escape sequences PTT added, not the parser: a final byte it has no case for still eats the screen, and PTT's `ESC[6n` on 9/27 is one. The patch description and the README note now say what the patch actually covers.

It shows up in Morphe Manager as `lchanc3` rather than `JPTT Patches`, and patches now live under `app.lchanc3.patches.<app>` with their extensions under `app.lchanc3.extension.<app>`, so a second app is a folder beside JPTT's instead of a rename. No patch behaves differently.

- Add **Wrap recent searches**: the 最近看板搜尋 / 最近搜尋 keywords in the article search dialog are laid out over as many lines as they need instead of one line you scroll sideways through. `dialog_search.xml` puts each list in a `HorizontalScrollView`, which is bearable for the five and fifteen keywords JPTT shows and not for the counts **More recent searches** allows. A list longer than a quarter of the screen scrolls within its own strip, so a long history cannot push the dialog's buttons off the bottom.

在 Morphe Manager 加入這個 patch 來源，或下載下面的 `.mpp` 手動匯入。

- Add **Fix article list loading**: PTT now brackets its screen repaints with the synchronized output sequences `ESC[?2026h` / `ESC[?2026l`. JPTT's terminal emulator has no case for the `h` and `l` final bytes, so it keeps appending to its 32 character escape buffer, swallowing the screen content that follows and printing fragments of the sequence as visible text. Entering a board never got past the wait for 請按任意鍵繼續 and the article list sat at 載入中 until it gave up with 載入失敗. This filters the sequences the emulator cannot parse out of the stream before they reach it.
- **Preload article images**: implement `onProgressUpdate` on the Fresco subscriber. `BaseDataSubscriber` in the APK has no implementation to inherit — R8 dropped the empty override because the one subclass it kept declares its own — so the first progress report from a download threw `AbstractMethodError` on Fresco's network thread, where none of this extension's `catch` blocks can see it, and the app died on opening any article with images. Also handle `onCancellation`, so a cancelled fetch releases its worker immediately instead of after the 90 s timeout.

- Retains `com.mixplorer.beta` **6.71.15-BETA**, ARM64 build **26090412**.

All eight tests pass. Official Morphe recognizes both exact targets. Stable MiXplorer passed startup, native single-file and two-file receiver checks, and same-UID path checks on a Galaxy A71 running Android 13. Both shared payloads matched their source SHA-256 hashes.

Beta previously passed the same device checks with 0.1.0; patch application was rechecked with 0.2.0. **No live Telegram UI/network upload was tested.** The diagnostic receiver models Telegram's file-reading behavior.

Only the patch bundle and source are distributed, not modified APKs or signing keys.

## What's new in v1.47.0

### YouTube

- **Hide AI features**
  - Hide AI-generated video summaries.
  - Hide Ask buttons and AI entry points from video descriptions, video action buttons, and quick actions.

- **Channel playback speed defaults**
  - Set a playback speed for specific channels.
  - Format: `Channel ID=1.5`
  - Add one channel per line.

- **Channel video quality defaults**
  - Set a default video resolution for specific channels.
  - Format: `Channel ID=1080`
  - Add one channel per line.

- **Search cleanup controls**
  - Added grouped controls for reducing Shorts and web-search clutter in the feed and search experience.

- **Channel page sections controls**
  - Added grouped controls for hiding channel tabs and selected channel-page sections, including featured playlists and videos.

- **Video metadata controls**
  - Added grouped controls for hiding view counts, upload times, and timestamps.

After changing these settings, restart YouTube to apply all changes.

## Installation note

These builds are signed with a custom keystore. Uninstall any existing TikTok (stock or previously patched) before first install; subsequent updates from this workflow install in place.

Hushfacebook 0.2.0 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74, and 577.0.0.50.72 still works. It's the batch of fixes held back since 0.1.8, with 27 patches now, five of them new.

New patches:

- **Install beside Meta's apps** (on by default). The official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace can now be installed next to a patched Facebook without `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION`. If you patched before, patch again and install over the top. It's an ordinary update and Facebook keeps its data.
- **Stop update prompts** (on by default). A patched Facebook can't install Meta's updates, so it stops asking.
- **Use the system font** and **Use the phone's emoji** (both off until you pick them in Manager) draw Facebook's text and emoji with your phone's own fonts.
- **Don't send reel watch history** (off until you pick it) keeps the list of reels you watch from going back to Facebook.

Other changes:

- Long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed to open Hushfacebook's settings (#2). A tap still does what it always did.
- Hide AI-detected posts has a second switch for Reels and Watch.
- The Video file name setting takes `{owner}` and `{posted}`, so `{owner}_{posted}` saves a video as `Some Page_20260925.mp4` (#6).
- An opt-in check tells you when a new Hushfacebook release is out. It's off by default and never downloads anything.
- The settings screen shows which rows open something, and the diagnostic report choices fit at large text sizes.
- The README has a Troubleshooting section for Manager's error messages and a section on what Meta can see.

The full list is in CHANGELOG.md.

The first Hushfacebook release: 13 Morphe patches for Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (the current release, out today) and 577.0.0.50.72, arm64-v8a.

## What it does

- Sponsored and promoted posts come out of the news feed without leaving a gap. So do suggested pages, Facebook's own upsell cards and its survey slots.
- Sponsored stories are gone, and so are the ads in Reels and Watch, including the product banners over a reel and the ads inside a video.
- Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and stops serving Audience Network ads to other apps. Ad telemetry is blocked too.
- Links open in your own browser instead of Facebook's.
- You can save any story. Reels too, if you turn that patch on, and there's an AMOLED black theme if you want one.
- Screens that break on a re-signed Facebook (some settings pages and profiles) work again.

Long-press Facebook's icon and tap Hushfacebook for the settings. Every filter has its own switch, and there's a pause switch, debug logging and a diagnostic export. If Facebook crashes three times within a minute of starting, Hushfacebook pauses itself so you can get back in.

## Installing

Add the source in Morphe Manager 1.31.0 or newer (the link is in the README), then patch the arm64-v8a Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 bundle from APKMirror. The .mpp attached here is the patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. SHA256SUMS.txt has its checksum, and the release receipt records what it was checked against.

## What was checked

All 13 patches applied to the real 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 bundles with no manifest changes, and every stock resource still resolves in the patched APK. 72 extension tests and 72 of the 73 patch tests passed. The one left over checks that the upstream mirror links in the source notices still answer, and gitlab.com was down when this was built.

On a Samsung Galaxy S25 with Android 16, Morphe Manager patched Facebook 580 with the default selection and installed it as an update over an older patched copy. The account stayed signed in and Facebook ran without a crash. Nobody has confirmed yet that each filter removes what it should on a live feed, so bug reports with a diagnostic export are very welcome.

## Where it comes from

Most patches are ported from Andrew Liang's Morphe patches and fixed for 580. FroggoMorphePatches contributed ideas, and Hushfeed the build, the shared extension library and the release checks. All of it is GPL-3.0. docs/sources.md covers every Facebook patch source we looked at.

## 1.0.0 (2026-09-26)

### ✨ New Features

* publish Anghami 8.0.28 patches ([d901fbe](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/d901fbe7750a593804b17d56e3dc6b7b400ee707))

This release gathers everything since v0.10.0 and brings 88 patches for Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, up from 87. The new one is `Frame step`, which moves a paused reel or video one frame at a time. New switches hide comments with shop links or with words from your News feed list, let Home show just Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages, and save crashes to Downloads so they can go with a bug report. The kept reel progress bar no longer jumps back on the first reel or sits under the caption, Material You reaches the Menu's top card and Log out strip, and the Reported issues list below maps each report this release touches.

New in this release

- New patch, `Frame step`, under Playback (issue #95). With it on, pause a reel or a video and tap the right third of the picture to move one frame forward, or the left third to move one frame back. The middle third plays it again, and taps on a playing video work as before. It starts off, and the report counts the steps each way.

- Two new switches under Comments in `Comment sheet options`, `Hide comments with shop links` and `Hide comments with your words` (issue #118). The first leaves out comments that link to Shopee, Lazada, Tokopedia, AliExpress, Temu, Shein, TikTok Shop or Amazon's short links, replies and all. The second leaves out comments holding something from your News feed `Words to hide` list, unless they also have something from `Words that keep a post`, so the one list now covers posts and comments. Both start off, and the report counts what each one hid.

- `Following feed on Home` has a new row under it, `Home shows`, for people who want Home to be just their friends. Pick Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages and Home asks Facebook for that filter's newest posts, the same ones the Feeds tab shows under it. All, the default, keeps Home as it was. If your Facebook doesn't have the filter you picked, Home shows All, and the diagnostic report counts which feed Home asked for. The choice travels in an exported settings file.

- New switch under Privacy, `Save crashes to Downloads`, in every build and on from the start. When Facebook crashes, the error goes in a text file in Download/Hushfacebook, so it can go with a bug report even when Facebook won't open far enough to reach the settings. It holds the diagnostic report's crash section, with links and IDs left out, and the newest five are kept. Nothing is written while Hushfacebook is paused. The bug form now says where to find it.

Fixes

- A link to a site that isn't Meta's shows up in the diagnostic report's list of screens opened as "(outside link)" and nothing more. The list used to keep the site and the page's path, so a report could name a page you read in Facebook's browser or a file you opened from it.

- Finished-save cards don't pile up any more. The shade keeps the newest twenty "Video saved" and "Photo saved" cards and lets the oldest go. Android stops an app at about fifty notifications and drops the next without a word, which could leave the next save's progress card, Cancel button and all, with no room to show.

- When the phone's decoder gives no sample rate for a reel's xHE-AAC sound, or changes its format part way through, the save falls back to Facebook's single file where there is one and the log says why. The first case used to end in a division by zero. The second would have gone on into sound that comes out wrong.

- Cancel, Pause, Resume, Undo, Add a topic pack, Back and Clear search in the settings show a ripple when tapped. They showed nothing before.

- `Turn off HDR brightness` also asks the phone's video decoder to bring an HDR video down to the usual range on Android 12 and newer (issue #93). Until now only the window was told to stay in the usual range, and a video the phone's own decoder plays, like a VP9 HLG reel, could still light the screen up. A decoder that turns the request down is set up again without it, so the video still plays, and the diagnostic report counts which way each decoder answered.

- With `Tap to play` on, a reel that's waiting for your tap no longer goes into picture-in-picture when you leave Facebook (issue #90). The window used to stay armed from the reel before, so going home opened a floating player for a reel you hadn't started. Once you tap play, leaving works as it did. A reel you were watching in the floating player also keeps playing when you open it back up into Facebook. Facebook pauses it on the way back and starts it again, and Tap to play used to hold that start, so the reel sat with its play button over the time you'd already watched.

- Facebook's push service no longer turns down a patched Facebook (issue #112). On a re-signed build it checked Facebook's certificate, didn't recognize it, stopped and got started again, over and over, and each round could leave threads running, which can drain the battery. It now gets Facebook's original certificate for that check, the same fix HushThreads got for Threads. It's part of every build, whichever patches you pick.

- A save WhatsApp may refuse shows one card in the shade. It has Open and Share like any finished save, says why the video may be refused and adds an `Open the setting` button. It used to post a second card next to the finished-save one.

- Two saves finishing in the same moment keep twenty finished-save cards. Each one trimmed the shade on its own, so they could both let a card go and leave nineteen.

- The Messenger link test under Links writes its result into its own row, where it stays readable. It used to show as a long toast that some phones cut short.

- With `Keep the progress bar` and `Show a reel's time` on, the first reel's bar no longer jumps back to the start while it plays (issue #120). The time above the bar was refreshed before Facebook had checked that the reel's player was ready, and the code that writes the time moves the bar too, so each refresh could put the bar back at 0:00 until the player caught up. The time is now refreshed only after Facebook has moved the bar itself.

- After you pick a different app icon, the `Hushfacebook settings` shortcut on a long press of the icon opens the settings again (issue #119). Picking an icon switches Facebook's usual launcher entry off and the icon's own entry on, and the shortcut still pointed at the one that was off, so tapping it did nothing. It now points at whichever entry is on, and so do the buttons on a notification that open a setting and the Open and Share buttons on a saved file's card. The shortcut catches up the next time Facebook starts.

- With `Default comment order` set to All comments, a friend's post no longer opens with no comments (issue #110). Asking for All comments up front got some posts an empty answer, while Newest and Most relevant got their comments. Comments now open in Facebook's order first, and when the post's sort menu offers All comments, it's picked there the same way a tap does. A post without that choice keeps Facebook's order.

- With `Keep the progress bar` on, a playing reel's caption no longer sits on top of the bar and its time (issue #73). Facebook moves the caption up only while a reel is paused, so it now keeps that paused layout while the reel plays too. Short reels whose bar showed for a moment and then faded out keep it as well. The diagnostic report counts any reel whose bar Facebook still hides.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the card at the top of Menu with your name and picture takes your palette, and so does the strip behind Log out at the bottom (issue #37). Facebook's server sends the card's gray along with the Menu's layout, and the strip loads the gray Facebook keeps for cards as a picture, two paths the theme didn't reach.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the Create story tile at the start of the stories tray takes your palette under your picture (issue #37). Facebook writes that gray straight into its code for dark mode.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the box under a link post's picture takes your palette in the feed as well (issue #37). The 0.10.0 fix waited for Facebook to say dark mode was on, and Facebook lays out the first posts of a cold start before it says so, so those boxes could stay gray.

- In Indonesian and Turkish, the Following feed on Home summary and the Feeds header call the Feeds tab by the same name as the rest of those settings ("Feed" and "Akışlar"). They said "Feeds".

Other changes

- Summaries and toasts call the Marketplace switch's state Marketplace only, like the switch does. Some said "Marketplace mode", which isn't a name you'd find in the settings search.

- The seen posts row is called `Keep seen posts hidden for`, so it makes sense on its own in the settings search. While `Hide posts you've already seen` is off, its summary says to turn that on first.

- Ready for Android 17, which Samsung phones are getting with One UI 9. The reels filters that drop items from a section no longer treat a list the section's class keeps for itself as the section's items. Writing back into one of those is refused once Facebook targets Android 17, and could change every section at once before that. CONTRIBUTING.md lists what else Android 17 changes and why the rest doesn't touch Hushfacebook, and the settings and pause tests also run on Android 17 now.

- `Unlock app icons` says where to pick an icon (issue #122). The icons are on Facebook's own App icon page, at Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon, and the switch's summary used to say only "its App icon page". Patch descriptions in Morphe Manager say the same now.

Reported issues

- #120 Progress bar resetting with Keep the progress bar on: the first reel's bar moves on from where the reel is and goes back to the start only when the reel does.

- #119 Hushfacebook settings not opening from a long press on the icon: after you pick a different app icon, the shortcut opens the settings again once Facebook has restarted.

- #110 Comment sorting: with `Default comment order` on All comments, a friend's post opens with its comments, and All comments is picked in the post's own sort menu where it has one.

- #73 Keep the reel progress bar visible: a playing reel's caption stays above the bar and its time, and short reels keep the bar.

- #37 Material You in dark mode: the card at the top of Menu, the strip behind Log out, the Create story tile and the link boxes Facebook lays out first on a cold start take your palette.

- #122 and #109 Unlocked icons: the `Unlock app icons` switch says where the icons are, Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon.

- #90 Elapsed time on a reel before tapping play: a reel waiting for your tap stays out of picture-in-picture, and a reel coming back from the floating player keeps playing.

- #93 HDR videos with Turn off HDR brightness on: the switch also asks the phone's video decoder to keep HDR video in the usual range.

- #95 Frame mode: the new `Frame step` patch moves a paused reel or video one frame at a time.

- #118 Hiding promotional link comments: `Hide comments with shop links` and `Hide comments with your words` under Comments.

- #112 Battery drain on a re-signed build: Facebook's push service accepts a patched Facebook instead of stopping and restarting over and over.

Behind the scenes

New in this release
