With the switch on you can pick any of them, and Facebook switches your home screen icon to it and keeps it when it restarts or you update Hushfacebook. Facebook puts its own icon back on the first start after an update, and the switch stops that. Turned off, your pick stays until the next update, so pick the blue icon first if you want it back sooner. It's in Manager's default selection with its switch off.

- `Stop link history in Facebook's browser`, a new switch under Privacy that comes with Open links in external browser and starts on. Links that still open in Facebook's own browser, like Facebook's pages or any link on a phone with no other browser, aren't recorded for your link history or sent to Facebook as pages you visited. The browser just never builds its two link recorders, which is what it does when Facebook turns the feature off. Login, checkout and autofill keep working, and your Enhanced browsing setting stays as it is.

- `Hold back camera roll processing`, a second switch in Hold back analytics uploads under Privacy, which starts off. The processing behind camera roll sharing suggestions goes through your photos and videos, runs Facebook's models on them and uploads photos with what it found, and another job tells Facebook how many photos and videos you have. Facebook's server decides whether they run, and the app asks one check before it schedules or runs the work. With the switch on that answer is no, so Facebook cancels the work it scheduled, and the count job is cancelled too. Photos you pick to post go another way and never ask it.

- `Show a reel's time`, a new switch right below Keep the progress bar that starts on (issue #73). While the bar is kept, a reel's elapsed and total time stay above it and keep counting. Turn it off to see the time only while you drag, as before.

- `Watch history shortcut`, a new switch under Menu that starts off (issue #114). Turn it on and holding Facebook's icon offers Watch history, the videos and reels you've watched, when there's room next to Facebook's own shortcuts. The Menu's Settings and privacy group gets a Watch history row too. Both open Facebook's Videos you've watched page.

Behind the scenes

- The contributor guide maps patch sources, runtime extensions, and the patch workflow. The Facebook 581 audit traces ad delivery and tracking controls, records the signed-in stock screens, and measures foreground, background and screen-off activity. It includes network metadata, two settings screenshots and code search targets for browser history, camera-roll processing and the Facebook Plus icon screen in #109. It separates observed behavior from paths that still need a device check.

- `scripts/phone-smoke.ps1` walks a patched Facebook on a phone through the feed, Watch, Reels, notifications and Marketplace, saves a full diagnostic report from Hushfacebook settings and pulls it. It fails when a hook family reports anything missing, ambiguous or thrown, when a family you name with `-ExpectInvoked` never ran, or when Facebook crashed during the walk. A crash the report kept from before the walk doesn't count. `scripts/test-phone-smoke.ps1` checks the report reading without a phone.

- Settings tests now match the current patch list, switch defaults and supported-link explanation. Story privacy tests clear shared diagnostic counters before each case so an earlier test can't change their results.

- The desktop CLI runs, bundle merges and the resource, register and fingerprint checks now wait for a slot of the machine's build queue when `BUILD_QUEUE_SCRIPT` names one, and run straight away when it doesn't. Before, they started beside whatever builds were running and the queue never saw them.

- The patch tests that read the Facebook fixtures run as their own Gradle task, `:patches:fixtureTest`, with each fixture's path and SHA-256 as its inputs. A change to the fixtures reruns only those tests, and a fixture swapped for another of the same size and date still counts as a change. Each fixture's dex is now read and parsed once per test run rather than once per lookup. `:patches:test` still runs every test, and refuses a run where a fixture test skipped with the fixture folder set.

- The pre-push gate runs Gradle twice. Everything but the fixture tests goes first, so a failing quick test or lint stops the push in minutes, and the full run with the fixture tests comes second. `scripts/release/release.ps1 -Stage preflight` runs the quick checks a release needs in about five minutes: the script contracts, that same quick patch run, the translation and release-check tests, both lints and the release facts.

- `tools/release_text.py` writes a release's text. `cut` turns Unreleased into the dated section with a Facebook summary first, `bump` moves the version and the README badge, `check-translations` holds every table to the same strings and `L10nTranslations.java` to the tables, `github-notes` writes the notes with every bullet kept and checks that the app's update check reads the newest declared build from them, and `index` writes `patches-bundle.json`, the README's latest-release sentence and the bug form. Its tests run with `py -3.13 -I -m unittest discover -s tools -p "test_*.py"`.

- A release patches each Facebook fixture once instead of twice. The pre-push gate now patches the fixtures with the release bundle from `build/release` when the patch sources or the version change, and keeps each passing run with a stamp naming the bundle, APK, patch list and CLI. `build-release-receipt.ps1 -AppliedDir` reads a kept run whose stamp matches and runs every check on it, and patches any other fixture as before.

- `scripts/release/release.ps1` runs the whole release in five stages, each refusing to start until the one before it is done. `source` cuts the CHANGELOG, bumps the version, writes the patch list and checks the translations, and puts the tree back if a step fails. `preflight` adds the release text tests, the translation check and a draft of the GitHub notes to its quick checks. `bundle` builds from the pushed source commit and writes the receipt from the gate's kept runs plus `SHA256SUMS.txt`. `publish` tags, creates the release and downloads every asset back to compare it. `index` writes `patches-bundle.json`, the README and the bug form from the published release and the gate's test counts, then updates the repository description. The pre-push gate now runs the release text tests and the script contract tests when only `tools/` changes, and the phone smoke report checks when `phone-smoke.ps1` changes.

The diagnostic report now counts every ad-break request the patch holds back, banners and video ad breaks included.

- `Hide posts by words` can also hide posts from people, Pages and sites you list. Turn on `Hide posts from people, Pages and sites` under News feed and add one per line to its list: a name as Facebook shows it, a profile or Page id or a Facebook link with one in it, or a site like example.com, which takes its subdomains too. A share of a listed author's post goes as well, and a link through Facebook's own redirect counts as the site it leads to. The list stays on the phone and goes into an exported settings file like the word lists.

- `Hide posts by words` takes patterns as well as words. A line between slashes, like /colou?r/, is a regular expression, and each one runs with a step limit so a bad pattern can't freeze the feed, and one whose repeats would take too long just to read is turned down. Save names the first line it can't read. Four new switches under News feed hide photo, video, link and colored background posts, and they all start off. A Page's video with a button under it, like Get tickets, counts as a video post.

- `Hide suggested and promoted posts` has three more switches under News feed, for things Facebook puts between posts that aren't suggestions: Memories, like "On this day" and friendship anniversaries, the row of friend requests, and the card showing where your friends are. Each starts off. Your Memories page and the requests under Friends stay either way.

- `Hide suggested and promoted posts` also takes two more kinds of Facebook's own promotions, its social list prompt and the row of people to invite to a group. It goes by the type name each one carries, since some builds send them without a model class of their own. `Hide sponsored posts` also takes a carousel of several ads, whatever category Facebook files it under.

- `Hide Stories tray` has a third switch, `Hide the composer row` under News feed, which starts off. Notifications still come in. Every switch starts off.

Turn on `Turn off auto-translation` under News feed, and posts Facebook would translate by itself keep their own text with its See translation link under them, while reels stop asking for a caption translation. Turn it on and a playback speed you pick in a feed or Watch video's gear menu carries to the next videos you play, until you pick another or Facebook restarts. Reels keep their own speed, and ads, live videos, stories and videos in chats start at Facebook's speed. It starts off.

With `Open every reply thread`, comments show their replies right away, the way they look after a tap on View replies. - `Download any video` has a new switch, `Offer to download copied links`, off to start. Come back to Facebook with a reel or video link copied and it asks once whether to download it. With the switch off, your clipboard is never read.

The black screen stays on top of Facebook's popups and tooltips, and Open and Share on a saved photo or video wait until you unlock. A reel in picture-in-picture keeps playing in its window without asking, but bringing it back or opening Facebook after that time asks, and a reply from a notification doesn't ask. Instant Games and their ads ask too, following the switch and the wait you pick even while they're already open, but a game opened soon after you unlock Facebook doesn't ask again. - `Block promotional notifications` has new switches for group activity, event invites, live videos and reactions to your posts and comments. `Quiet hours`, a separate switch, blocks the kinds you picked only between two hours you choose (10 PM to 7 AM to start). Everything starts off, and messages and calls always come through.

- `Block background-return feed refresh` also keeps your place when Facebook would reload Home as you switch back to it after a while on another tab. The `Keep feed position on return` switch covers it, and pull to refresh and a fresh start still load new posts.

- `Hold a reel for 2x` has a new switch, `Only on the right edge`, off to start. With it on, only a hold on the right third of a reel plays it at 2x, and a hold anywhere else opens Facebook's long-press menu, even on accounts where Facebook has a 2x hold of its own on the reel's edges.

- `Text size` under Appearance makes Facebook's text 85% to 130% of what your phone's font size setting gives it. It starts at 100%, which is Facebook as it ships, and Pause puts it back. Restart Facebook after changing it.

- New patch, `Accent color`, left out of Manager's default selection. Pick Teal, Green, Purple, Pink, Orange, Red, Indigo or Amber under Appearance and the blue Facebook draws links, buttons, switches and the selected tab in takes that color. Blue text and icons on a card keep 4.5 to 1 contrast in whichever look the screen uses, light or dark. It starts on Facebook's blue. `Material You theme` wins when both are in, and the Accent color row greys out to say so.

- New patch, `Send chat photos and videos at original quality`, with a switch under Chats that starts off. Photos and videos you send from a chat that opens inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of shrunken copies. Photos lose their location and camera details (the rotation stays). A video with a location tag or a dashcam's GPS log (a gps box, NMEA text, Novatek freeGPS blocks or LigoGPS data) is still re-encoded, and so is one holding anything Hushfacebook can't read through, such as a camera maker's binary Exif box or an XMP packet. Videos from editing apps and Galaxy phones with no location in them go out as they are. One sent as it is keeps its recording date and the phone's make and model. Photos over 20 MB and videos over 25 MB are still shrunk.

A pack adds its words as a few pattern lines you can edit, and they only match whole words, so a friend's "love you to the moon and back" stays put. It skips lines you already have and says what it added right in the editor, and nothing is kept until you save.

- `Hide posts by words` can also hide posts with a lot of reactions. Pick a count under `Hide posts with more reactions than`, from 1,000 to 100,000, and posts above it go. It starts on Off, and a post whose count can't be read stays.

- New patch, `Hide seen posts`, left out of Manager's default selection. Turn on `Hide posts you've already seen` under News feed and posts you've scrolled past stay out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7 or 30 days as you pick under `Keep them hidden for`. `Forget seen posts` starts over, with the switch on or off, and turning the switch off forgets the list too. The list is a short code per post and when you saw it, kept on your phone only, cleared of posts past their days and left out of exported settings.

- New patch, `Clean up Facebook's chat list`, for Chats that open inside Facebook. `Hide the notes and active now row` empties the list behind the row above your chats, so friends' notes and who's active go, and your own note tile may go too. `Hide chat list promotions` takes out the promotional banners at the top, like the one asking you to turn on notifications. Both switches start off.

- `Only the first reel waits`, a switch under Playback below `Tap to play` that starts off. With it on, the reel you land on in Reels still waits for a tap, and the reels you swipe to after you play it start on their own. The feed, Watch and stories keep waiting, and once anything waits again, like the feed trying a video or a reel coming back from another tab, so does the next reel (issue #91).

- `Slower speeds`, a switch under Reels and Watch that starts off. A reel's speed menu and the gear menu's Playback speed sheet on feed and Watch videos also offer 0.1x and 0.25x, slower than Facebook's 0.5x, for reading a sign or catching a detail that goes by too fast. The gear sheet writes the new speeds the way it writes its own, like 0,25x in German, and plays the speed you tap whatever language your phone is in. Keep the reel speed and Keep the video speed keep a slow speed you pick like any other (issue #95).

- `Facebook's Whitehat settings`, under Pause, backup and diagnostics, opens Facebook's own screen for security researchers when it's on the phone, and the Whitehat page on the web when it isn't.

- With Debug logging on, the report's Stories tray line is followed by a count of the other card types the tray kept, by Facebook's own type name, so a report shows which cards Hushfacebook doesn't sort yet. It never reads whose stories they are and doesn't change what the tray shows.

- With Debug logging on, the diagnostic report says which video formats Facebook's players were set up with: the codec, the size, and whether the picture is SDR or HDR (PQ or HLG), with or without HDR metadata. So a report shows whether a video was really served in HDR, with `Turn off HDR brightness` on or off. It's in every build, and nothing else from the video gets into the report (issues #93 and #66).

- With Debug logging on, a Save photo tap writes the sizes of the photo's copies to the report (just the sizes, never the image's address), so a report can show why a save came out smaller than expected.

- The report's Last screen left lines now say what each view on the way down paints behind itself (a colour, or the kind of drawable with its fill), so a report can show which part of a screen a theme missed. A sheet or dialog left open over the screen, like the comments, gets read first, and the walk also looks under an empty layer that paints nothing.

- With Debug logging on, the log names each colour token `Material You theme` leaves at one of Facebook's dark grays, once per token, so a report can show where the theme missed a gray (issue #37).

Fixes

- With `Use the system font` on, the bottoms of letters like y, g and p no longer get cut off in menus, captions and buttons on phones whose font draws lower than it says it does. Facebook lays its text out tight to the font's own measurements, which only fit Meta's font, so text in a font like that now gets the extra room Android's own apps give it (issue #96).

- `Hide sponsored reels` catches the reel ads that still showed in the Reels tab on 581 (issues #47 and #35). Facebook's newer Reels loader adds a reel on its own, or a page at the end of the list, and only tells the screen afterwards. The patch was taking the ad out of that message, so the report counted it as dropped while the ad stayed in the list. Now the ad never goes in. `Hide AI-detected posts` had the same gap for AI-labelled reels and gets the same fix. The report counts that message on its own line, Reels announcements, so the Reels pages line counts each reel once.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, a sheet or dialog that opens over a screen, like the comments, takes the palette on its plain dark gray backgrounds too, the comment rows and the Write a comment bar with its top border included (issue #37).

- `Hide affiliate product links` takes the other Shop now cards off reels too, like the one above the creator's name for a product of their own. Facebook sends products tagged on a reel, a creator's storefront and Shop similar as card kinds of their own, and the patch only caught the affiliate one. The diagnostic report counts each card it keeps out by its kind (issue #89).

- With `AMOLED theme` on, the Data mode banner that Flex carriers show under the top bar draws on the black page now, not as a dark grey band across it. Facebook paints that strip with a card's colour, and AMOLED had turned it a card's near black. The Buy data button keeps its own step above the black (issue #86).

- `Turn off HDR brightness` also answers no when Facebook checks whether the screen shows HDR. On a screen that shows HLG, that check is what lets Facebook brighten ordinary videos into HDR on Android 14 and newer, and it's also how Facebook picks a Dolby Vision video's HDR track. Until now the patch only held back Facebook's HDR window, which reaches a video drawn on a surface of its own from Android 15 on (issue #93).

- With `Tap to play` on, the reel you land on when you open the Reels tab waits for a tap again. Facebook 581 starts those reels the way it autoplays a feed video, so the tap on the tab counted as asking for it. Tap to play now checks whether the player holds a reel, and a feed video or a story you tap still starts as before.

- When Facebook closes with "Facebook keeps stopping", the next diagnostic report you export shows the error and where in the code it happened, with the last few events before it. Android only records that a crash happened, so a report sent afterwards couldn't say why. The crash stays on your phone, cleaned of addresses and ids, and goes in every report you export until a later crash replaces it or you tap Clear diagnostic data (issue #94).

Other changes

- `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers` also answers the seller page's flag when it's read by its number instead of its name. Facebook's React Native pages can ask for a flag either way, so a page that switches over keeps the button.

- `Picture-in-picture` now also covers a video playing in Facebook's full-screen Watch viewer or in the Video tab, using the window Facebook already has in both, behind the same `Picture-in-picture` switch. A paused video in the viewer doesn't open one, and in the Video tab Facebook still keeps ads and live videos out of it.

- With Debug logging on, opening Menu writes the parts of its layout that mention Muse or Get app to the log, so an exported report shows what the Muse card is made of. Only what's on screen is read, a parent component's own text is left out, and it stops once the card turns up.

- With Debug logging on, a long press on a reel does the same for every window Facebook shows a moment later, so a report also shows what the long-press menu's share row is made of, where Muse is listed first.

- With Debug logging and `Resume long videos` on, the log says where each reel was as it started, how long it is and where Facebook asked it to start, to help track down reels whose seekbar shows time gone before they play (issue #90).

- The README's list of patches that are off by default names all 32 again, `Hide Meta upsells`, `Hide read receipts` and `Hide typing indicator` included, and its notes on switches that start off no longer repeat themselves.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 1.34.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `581.0.0.45.58`. On most phones that's build `475215365`, which APKMirror labels (arm64-v8a) (320-640dpi) (Android 11+). Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `475215364`, labelled (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+). Facebook `580.0.0.51.74`, build `475019344`, and `577.0.0.50.72`, build `474426275`, still work.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 2276 runtime tests and 820 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 85 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 581.0.0.45.58 (both builds), 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check found no advisory for gson 2.14.0, kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 or annotations 13.0.

This release gathers everything since v0.7.1 and brings 70 patches for Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, up from 60. 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 still work, and phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch 581 now too. The ten new ones are `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers`, `Turn off HDR brightness`, `Picture-in-picture`, `Turn off screen transitions`, `Turn off haptics`, `Block Instant Games ads`, `Hide tabs`, `Block screenshot detection`, `Allow screenshots` and `Hold back analytics uploads`. Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer is required.

New in this release

- New patch, `Show View profile on Marketplace sellers`, in the default selection with its switch under Marketplace. A seller's page in Marketplace has Facebook's own View profile button, which opens the seller's regular Facebook profile, but Facebook only gives it to some accounts. Everyone else gets Follow, Message and More, with no way to check who's selling. With the switch on, every seller's page has View profile next to More and in the More sheet too (issue #68).

- New patch, `Turn off HDR brightness`, with its switch under Playback. Facebook turns the screen up for HDR videos and photos in the feed, stories and Reels, which flashes the screen brighter as you scroll past one. With the switch on they play in the screen's usual range at the same resolution, and on Android 15 and newer that covers videos Facebook plays on a surface of their own too. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. Off or paused, Facebook's HDR comes back from the next screen you open (issue #66).

- New patch, `Picture-in-picture`, with its switch under Playback. A reel playing in the Reels tab keeps going in a small window when you go Home or switch apps. A paused reel doesn't open one, and after a swipe the window plays the reel you swiped to. It's the picture-in-picture Facebook already built for its Reels viewer, which it turns on for some accounts, so the window is Facebook's own. It needs Android 12 or later, it's off in Manager's default selection, and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook picture-in-picture patch. Checked on a phone with 581: a playing reel went on playing in the window after Home, a paused one opened no window, the reel a swipe brought up played in it, and with Tap to play on the reel being watched kept playing there.

- New patch, `Turn off screen transitions`, with its switch under Appearance. A tap on a tab or the Menu button shows that page at once instead of sliding to it, and a screen that opens over Facebook, like the post composer, appears and closes without its slide. Swiping between tabs still follows your finger. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on a tab, the Menu and the composer show at once, and with it off each slides in for about a quarter of a second as before.

- New patch, `Turn off haptics`, with its switch under Appearance. Facebook plays a short vibration on many of its own taps and gestures, and with the patch picked and its switch on, those don't play. Your keyboard, your phone's own haptics and a call's ring stay. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from De-Vanced's Facebook clean-up patch. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on the Menu button opens with no tick, and with it off the tick plays.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` has a new switch, Hide Meta AI in the feed, under News feed. It takes out the Meta AI cards Facebook adds to the feed between posts, by the card's own type, so people's posts stay whatever they say about AI. It starts on.

- `Hide AI-detected posts` also has a Hide AI character posts switch, right below that one. It takes out posts featuring one of Meta's AI characters, the Creator AI and AI Studio characters you can chat with, found by the attachment style Facebook draws a character with. Those are still someone's posts, so the switch starts off.

- Phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch Facebook 581.0.0.45.58. Pick its 32-bit build for Android 11 and newer, 475215364 on APKMirror. It keeps its code readable the way the 64-bit build does, and every patch applies to it.

- New patch, `Block Instant Games ads`, in the default selection with its switch under Menu. A game you play in Facebook that asks for an ad, whether a full-screen one, a rewarded one or a banner, is told there's none to show, the answer Facebook gives when it has no ad. So nothing is fetched or played, a rewarded ad gives no reward, and the game carries on. The idea comes from De-Vanced, which drops those asks.

- `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` also covers Marketplace's video ads. The two components that draw one in the feed draw nothing while the switch is on, and the ad's video isn't fetched. The diagnostic report counts them on its Marketplace ads line. The idea comes from De-Vanced's ad patch.

- New patch, `Hide tabs`, with a switch under Appearance for each of the Feeds, Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming and Events tabs. Turn one on and that tab leaves the tab bar once Facebook restarts. Its page stays in the Menu and opens there on a screen of its own, and a start tab set to it opens Home. Checked on a phone with 581, with Friends and Marketplace hidden and then brought back. It's in Manager's default selection with every switch off. The idea comes from Loukious, which hides the Marketplace and Games tabs.

- New patch, `Block screenshot detection`, under Privacy. Facebook watches for screenshots across the app, in the feed, Reels, chats, games, Marketplace and ads, and on Android 14 and newer it can ask Android to report screenshots and screen recordings. With the patch picked and its switch on, it never finds out, so whatever it would do about a screenshot doesn't happen. Checked on a phone with 581: with the switch on, screenshots taken in the feed and in Reels never reach Facebook's screenshot check, and with it off they do. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot detection patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Allow screenshots`, under Privacy. Facebook blocks screenshots and screen recordings on a few pages, which come out black. With the patch picked and its switch on, those pages show up in screenshots, recordings and the recent apps view like any other. A page that's already open changes the next time you open it. It's off in Manager's default selection and its switch starts on once it's picked. The idea comes from ReVanced's screenshot patch, which Loukious and NexAlloy offer too.

- New patch, `Hold back analytics uploads`, under a new Privacy section. Facebook uploads how you use the app in the background, every three minutes while it's open, and runs Papaya jobs that train models on your phone and report back. With the patch picked and its switch on, the uploads don't start and the Papaya jobs end without running. It's off in Manager's default selection, its switch starts on once it's picked, and a change takes a restart of Facebook.

- With the Saved shortcut switch on, Facebook's Menu gets a Saved row at the end of Settings and privacy, right above Hushfacebook settings. It opens your saved items inside Facebook, and unlike the icon's long-press entry it shows on Samsung phones too. It comes with `Hushfacebook in the Menu`.

Those used to drop to Facebook's own MP4, which for a story can be 360p. The phone now turns the picture into H.264 and the sound into AAC-LC before joining them, which takes a few seconds for a 1080p reel, and the file keeps the colors the original states (issue #77).

The pool now answers the way it does when no slot is free, so the loader goes on with the next reel. Facebook isn't serving reel ads to the test accounts here, so this change is built from that report; the diagnostic report counts each ad held back (issues #47 and #35).

Facebook's Settings page comes from its servers, and on some tablets it has no Dark mode row at all, so there was no way to turn it on. The switch starts off. Turn it on and restart Facebook, and both dark themes follow it too. Pause Hushfacebook and Facebook goes back to its own setting once it restarts. Export settings carries the switch.

- A copy made with Morphe's **Clone app** now installs next to the official Facebook (issue #60). With Clone app's **Update permissions** off, which is how it comes, the copy kept five of Facebook's own permission names, and Android won't let a second app signed with another key declare them. Hushfacebook now moves those under the copy's own name and points everything that asks for one at the moved name, the same way it already moved the copy's providers.

Hushfacebook asks the Feeds tab once, the first time it shows after Facebook starts from its icon, through the same route Facebook uses for a link to a filter. When your tab bar has no Feeds tab, Facebook opens Home, and the filter is picked the first time you open Feeds from the Menu. Every filter you tap after that stays as you tapped it, and a link to the Feeds tab still opens where it leads. Friends, Groups and Pages are only on the Feeds tab that opens on the most recent posts, so the usual Feeds tab opens as it always does for those. Export settings carries the choice, and an import refuses a filter this version doesn't know.

The two lists share 56 KB of room, enough for 1,000 short phrases in each, so they always fit in an exported settings file. The line under each editor says how full that room would be as you type. Save turns down a list with too many phrases, or one that would overfill the room, and leaves the editor open with everything you typed, so nothing gets cut off. An import whose lists wouldn't fit changes nothing. Each post's text is now read once, however long the lists are, where before every phrase was looked for on its own.

Link ownership is read without changing it.

A large complete answer could bypass the old limit, and deeply nested data could exhaust the parser stack. When a limit is reached, its listings stay available and deferred fields still reach the correct result after an earlier ad was removed. Diagnostics count the reason without recording search content.

## Tooling

- The bundle is now built on Morphe patcher 1.15.0, the one Morphe Manager 1.33.0 ships, so Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer is required. Manager 1.32.0 turns the bundle down and asks you to update. Every patch applies the same way on Facebook 581, 580 and 577.

- Run the fixture checks of every patch on Facebook 581 as well. Where a build keeps a piece of text as a literal and another moves it into a lookup list (feed type names, Stories between posts, Messenger's link check), the tests accept either and check that the list really answers with that text.

- Check that every supported Facebook build still names Meta App Manager in its manifest's package queries. Facebook doesn't ask to see every app, so without that entry Android hides App Manager from it and the new row under Supported links would never show.

- Give the settings rows their own classes instead of borrowing the settings page's name, so code outside the settings package can't reach them and tests name them where they live. The page now keeps its Downloads section to itself. The translation check also reads a row helper called through the page's name, which it used to skip.

- Tighten how the system font patch spots a typeface compare. A static call on two objects now counts only when its own code does nothing but compare them, the way Kotlin's areEqual does, and any other call like that gets the picked font file. Both supported Facebook builds patch exactly as before.

- Stop the injected-register device check from clearing the log of a shared phone or emulator. It writes a line of its own to the log before dex2oat runs and counts only what comes after it, and it refuses the run when that line has already rolled out of the buffer. The fixture suite's fake ADB fails on any log clear and puts another run's lines ahead of the marker, so a tally that counts them fails too. It also puts another run's marker after this one, so a check that stops at any run's marker instead of its own fails as well.

- Review a new GPL Facebook Lite candidate, four forks and changed branch history. Shared Messenger compatibility constants now have a watch path. The 2026-10-02 census keeps historical and licensing restrictions and its public counts match the records.

- All 59 patches were verified on both supported Facebook builds with English, Arabic and Persian patcher locales. Each run passed the manifest, resource-table and injected-code checks, and every generated DEX matched the English run byte for byte. Existing instruction formatting already meets this requirement.

- Keep retired Facebook sources separate from active records while retaining their reachable historical code and license evidence. The census now checks whether a watched path still exists, so its deletion commit can't be mistaken for current Facebook code. A returning source or lost historical pin requires review.

- Enforce the real-codec test's subprocess deadline during execution. Temporary output files retain failure diagnostics without waiting for a pipe to close. Regression checks cover hanging tools, tracked descendants, nonzero exits and complete large output.

- Reuse expanded fixture DEX files between patch-anchor scans. The temporary cache checks the bundle's content hash and every reused DEX, refuses changed or corrupt bytes, and cleans up when the test worker exits. Existing checks still run on both exact Facebook builds.

- Align the Android test result-listener's HttpClient and HttpMime with 4.5.14. The compatibility gate rejects malformed URI authorities that the old parser routed to a host, while checking ordinary host selection and multipart report construction.

- Update the Android test transports to Netty 4.1.138.Final and Jetifier's settings dependency to JDOM2 2.0.6.1. Dependency changes now exercise both gRPC transports and the JDOM parser before a push, using the resolved artifact hashes. The shipping payload and Android plugin pairing stay the same.

- Record resolved settings-plugin, build and test dependency graphs separately from the payload SBOM. New release receipts bind the tooling report to their source and bundle, and publication refuses skipped audits, serious advisories and expired applicability reviews. Align Guava, Commons Lang and jose4j with their reviewed fixes.

Hushfacebook v0.4.0 gathers the fixes and additions since v0.3.4. It targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and still supports 577.0.0.50.72, with the same 43 patches.

## What's new

- **Clone app copies.** A copy of Facebook renamed with Morphe's Clone app patch recognises itself again, so Dark mode and Active status should open there (#16).
- **AMOLED black theme.** The status bar stays black when you come back to Facebook from Recent Apps, on the Reels and Video tabs too (#22).
- **Keep your feed.** Block background-return feed refresh has a new No time limit switch, so your place stays however long you're away (#23).
- **Saves.** Running saves are listed under Downloads with a Cancel button, which helps when notifications are off. A save cut short is cleaned up the next time Facebook starts. Error pages, oversized manifests and a full phone now stop a save sooner, and Cancel stops a video while its picture and sound are being joined.
- **Diagnostic reports.** Export diagnostic report always gives a report with your build details, even when nothing was logged. It leaves out more credentials and IDs, says what a saved video actually holds, and counts why a reel has no Download button (#18).
- **Feed filter.** Closes a way Facebook could swap sponsored posts into the news feed past the filter.
- **Settings.** A Supported links row shows whether Android opens facebook.com links in this app, with a shortcut to Android's page for it. Reels and Watch opens with a map of which switch hides which Reels surface. Search tells TalkBack how many settings it found, category pages say when Hushfacebook is paused, and settings import and export now report what was really saved.

Hushfacebook v0.3.4 brings together all changes since v0.2.0. It targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and retains support for 577.0.0.50.72. The bundle now has 43 patches, up from 27.

## What's new

- **Searchable settings.** A new overview leads to category pages, with search, clearer dialogs and a live preview for saved video names. Dark, light and wallpaper themes are supported.
- **Marketplace only.** Keep Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu in the tab bar. Optional quiet social notifications and feed preloading controls are available, with a way back to regular Facebook. The mode starts off.
- More filtering controls cover suggested Stories and Groups, Menu promotions, sponsored search/profile posts and Marketplace requests. Word lists can hide or keep posts, and creator-labelled AI posts have a separate opt-in switch.
- **Playback and saves.** Tap to play clears the initial play overlay when playback starts and stops a quick swipe from carrying a tap into the next Reel. Long-video resume is available. Compatible saves preserve known H.264/AAC pairs, and audio selection favors formats more players can handle.
- Choose a custom font file, open on a chosen tab, set the default comment order, limit tag suggestions to an explicit @, and block selected promotional notifications. Hushfacebook also has an entry in Facebook's Menu.

Hushfacebook 0.2.0 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74, and 577.0.0.50.72 still works. It's the batch of fixes held back since 0.1.8, with 27 patches now, five of them new.

New patches:

- **Install beside Meta's apps** (on by default). The official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace can now be installed next to a patched Facebook without `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION`. If you patched before, patch again and install over the top. It's an ordinary update and Facebook keeps its data.
- **Stop update prompts** (on by default). A patched Facebook can't install Meta's updates, so it stops asking.
- **Use the system font** and **Use the phone's emoji** (both off until you pick them in Manager) draw Facebook's text and emoji with your phone's own fonts.
- **Don't send reel watch history** (off until you pick it) keeps the list of reels you watch from going back to Facebook.

Other changes:

- Long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed to open Hushfacebook's settings (#2). A tap still does what it always did.
- Hide AI-detected posts has a second switch for Reels and Watch.
- The Video file name setting takes `{owner}` and `{posted}`, so `{owner}_{posted}` saves a video as `Some Page_20260925.mp4` (#6).
- An opt-in check tells you when a new Hushfacebook release is out. It's off by default and never downloads anything.
- The settings screen shows which rows open something, and the diagnostic report choices fit at large text sizes.
- The README has a Troubleshooting section for Manager's error messages and a section on what Meta can see.

The full list is in CHANGELOG.md.

One more for #137, reported right after 0.71.1 went out. A LIVE you open from the preview under a creator's card in search now gets Hide the status bar in LIVE rooms and Show a LIVE under the status bar too. TikTok opens that LIVE inside the page it uses for opened videos, and the switches never reached it there.

Here's every report the last three releases changed something for, and what changed.

Fixed in 0.71.2

* The status bar switches doing nothing on a LIVE opened from search (#137). They work there now, and swiping on to a video gives the bar back the way TikTok had it.

Fixed in 0.71.1

* Captions dropping to the bottom in Clear display (#141). The kept caption now sits where TikTok drew it before the controls went away.
* The strip under the clock not matching the LIVE (#137). With Show a LIVE under the status bar on, it's shaded like the rest of the top now.

Fixed in 0.71.0

* Progress bar on videos not showing (#134). It's back on For You, short videos included.
* Videos added to collections won't play (#135). Tapping a saved video plays that video again, and the feed filters leave lists you open alone.
* Animated stickers stuck in comments (#130). They move again. The switch behind it is now called Don't decode animated frames ahead.
* Creator name cut short next to the country (#127). The whole name shows when the row has room for both.
* Double tap for comments sometimes opened the share panel too (#63). A second tap held a moment too long no longer brings up the long press menu.
* Black status bar coming back in LIVE rooms (#137). It stays away for the whole LIVE. There's also a new Show a LIVE under the status bar switch.
* The small share sheet losing Report and Download (#120). Hide the Send to row hides only that row now.
* Puzzle pieces in LIVEs (#87). Protect external pages counts the CAPTCHA puzzle as one of TikTok's own pages, so it keeps its link back to TikTok.
* Passkeys (#102). A new Skip passkey sign-in patch lets TikTok offer your password or a code instead.
* TikTok's language resetting after a reboot (#61). The new Keep the app language patch keeps the language you picked in TikTok.
* The music disc not spinning (#68). Spin the music disc is new under Feed screen, along with Keep the music disc still.
* The button at the top left (#128). Hide feed LIVE button still patches on a build where that button can't be found.
* Progress bar over the creator's name on opened videos (#50). It sits under the caption again.
* Automatic Clear display (#84). Lots here. It clears videos opened from search or a link, the thin line and the loading bar go away with it, Fade the video controls works with it, and back or share no longer turn it off.

Added in 0.71.0 for requests

* Double tap and long press (#136). Double tap can do anything Long press does, and Long press can like the video.
* LIVE quality (#57). Offer LIVE quality in more rooms adds the picker to most rooms that didn't have one.
* Downloading stories (#93). Turn on Save a story from its share sheet under Downloads.
* A seek bar on stories (#72), and an always visible seek bar with a bigger handle and the time (#90). Both got new switches under Playback.
* Keep playing in the background (#99). Replay in the background starts a video over when it ends.
* A comment translate button (#85), and languages left untranslated (#121), where zh-TW and the other Traditional Chinese codes now keep Traditional Chinese.

Added to help track down

* The seek bar preview picture (#140). With Log diagnostics on, the log says how many preview pictures each video came with.
* TikTok's storage use (#70). The diagnostic report lists the biggest folders.
* Joining a LIVE by voice (#132) and the create tab closing (#133). Remove LIVE extras and Remove creation tools now say what they take out, so you can leave them out if you use those.

## What's changed

* Hide the status bar in LIVE rooms and Show a LIVE under the status bar now work on a LIVE opened from the preview under a creator's card in search too. TikTok opens that LIVE inside the page it uses for opened videos, which the switches didn't reach (#137).

Hushfeed v0.71.0 has 132 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer, since it's built on patcher 1.15.1.

Most of this one is fixes for things you reported. The progress bar is back on For You (#134), a collection plays the video you tapped (#135), animated comment stickers move again (#130) and long creator names stop getting cut short next to the country (#127). Two new patches keep the TikTok language you picked (#61) and let you sign in without a passkey (#102). The music disc can spin again (#68), Double tap can do anything Long press does (#136), and LIVE quality can be picked in more rooms (#57). Simple mode now picks 115 of the 132 patches. Six patches that used to work with no switch now have one, and it starts off, so if you used Skip the splash ad, Skip update checks, Limit background traffic, Drop the animated image cache, Stop on-device AI profiling or Enable voice comments, turn its switch on after you update.

## What's changed

* With Double tap set to one of Hushfeed's actions and Long-press controls patched in, a second tap your finger stays on a moment too long no longer brings up TikTok's long press menu as well, so the share panel stops opening on top of the comments. (#63)
* LIVE controls has a third switch, Offer LIVE quality in more rooms, under Hushfeed settings > Playback. TikTok offers Video quality in a LIVE's menu only when the stream asks for it or TikTok turns its newer quality picker on for your account, so in some rooms there was no way to pick one. With the switch on, most rooms without it get the newer picker (audio-only rooms still don't), and the next room opens at the quality you picked last until TikTok closes. It's off by default. (#57)
* Show dates on profile grids and Show engagement rate work on TikTok 47.1.4's grids now, on a profile's videos and on Favorites and liked videos too. That version sets each cell's view count in a place the patch didn't reach, so neither the date nor the rate showed up there.
* Blocked creators, blocked words, the view and like ranges and switches like Hide LIVE videos and Hide stories now work on the Following tab too. On TikTok 47.1.4 that tab only lost its ads and place-tagged videos, so a creator you'd blocked could still turn up there.
* A word that isn't a language code in Don't auto translate these languages now gets a plain "isn't a language code" message. It used to warn that no video would ever match, which is the caption language filter's warning and doesn't fit a list that only keeps text untranslated (#121).
* Build details now also names the patches that only change TikTok's resources, like Change app name, Custom launcher icon and Trust user certificates. It lists the patch, never the name or picture you picked in its options.
* With Log diagnostics on, the log now says once per video how many progress bar preview pictures TikTok sent with it. If the preview doesn't show while you drag the bar, a diagnostics export tells whether the video came with any (#140).
* Build details and the full log export now list every patch that changed TikTok's code in your build, by a short name, including the ones with no switch like Comment send fix and Network request report.
* Clear display, remembered or automatic, now also clears a video you open from search. TikTok hands that video to the opened page already playing, and Clear display waited for a start that never came there, so the buttons and TikTok's search bar stayed up (#84).
* Hide video overlays and Feed text sizes now also work when a link starts TikTok straight into search or a video, with no For You feed behind it. Before, the videos opened that way kept every overlay and TikTok's own text size (#84).
* Protect external pages in TikTok's browser now counts the puzzle CAPTCHA that LIVEs and the Shop open as one of TikTok's own pages, so the puzzle keeps its link back to TikTok (#87). It loads from TikTok's own servers, just not from an address the switch knew.
* A quick second tap on Build details, Hook status, Licenses or What's new no longer opens the same window twice, one on top of the other.
* Like the video, as a Double tap or Long press action, now stays with the video you're on in every kind of feed. Where that video has no heart to press, it tells you instead of liking the one next to it.
* A Double tap set to one of Hushfeed's actions now runs it once per tap, even if TikTok passes the same tap to two of its handlers.
* Patching a TikTok version Hushfeed doesn't list is safer. The extras of Show the progress bar and the comment translate button are now left out on their own when they don't fit that version, so they can't stop the patch or go in halfway.
* The Keep captions in Clear display and Automatic Clear display rows now spell Clear display the way TikTok does.
* With Hide the comment bar on opened videos on, the progress bar on a long video you open from search or a profile now sits under the caption again. Before, it drew across the creator's name (#50).
* Fade the video controls now also fades the progress bar on a paused video, the Following tab's stories pill, and on a video opened from search its top search bar, Full screen button and Add comment bar. Before, those stayed at full strength (#84).
* A story can now be saved from its share sheet. Turn on Save a story from its share sheet under Downloads and a save button shows up there. It saves the copy without the watermark when TikTok has one, and tells you when only the watermarked copy is there (#93).
* Show the progress bar has a new switch under Playback, Seek bar on video stories, which starts off. It puts a thin line along the bottom of a video story that you can drag to go back or skip ahead, with the time shown while you drag. Tapping still moves between stories (#72).
* Keep playing in the background can now start a video over when it ends, so you don't have to press Play in the notification each time. Turn on Replay in the background under Playback. A call or another app's sound still pauses it (#99).
* The music disc can spin again. TikTok 47.1.4 keeps it still out of the box, so Feed screen now has Spin the music disc, and Keep the music disc still if you'd rather it never turns. Both need a restart (#68).
* Show the progress bar has two new switches under Playback, both off at first. Show the time beside the progress bar adds the time played and the video's length at the end of the bar, and Bigger progress bar handle draws a larger handle on a slightly thicker line (#90).
* With Hide the Clear display controls on, TikTok's loading line, the thin bar that grows from the middle along the bottom of a video while it buffers, now goes too while the screen is cleared (#84).
* A new Translate button in comments switch under Comments shows TikTok's own translate button next to the comment count. One tap translates every comment and reply, and another brings the originals back (#85). It starts off.
* Clear display no longer leaves a thin line across the bottom of each new video for a few seconds (#84). It was the hairline along the top of the tab bar, which stayed behind when the tabs went away.
* Hide the status bar in LIVE rooms keeps the black strip at the top away for the whole LIVE (#137). It used to give up after TikTok put the strip back a few times, like when panels open and close over the stream. A new Show a LIVE under the status bar switch lets a LIVE reach the top edge with the clock and icons over it, if you'd rather keep the bar. It starts off.
* Double tap can now do anything Long press does, like copying the link or saving the frame, and Long press has a new Like the video choice (#136). A like from a long press works like TikTok's own and never takes a like away.

TikTok slips the videos it saved for offline viewing back into For You when it can't load enough new ones, and with the switch on they're all taken out, the whole offline fallback list included. Your offline list stays as it is, and Filter TikTok's offline videos greys out while the new switch is on.
* Long press has a new choice, Set a sleep timer that closes TikTok. The press opens a picker of 15, 30, 45, 60 or 90 minutes, and a toast says when TikTok will close. When the time runs out the video stops and TikTok closes the way a swipe away from Recents closes it, background play included. Pressing again while a timer runs offers to turn it off. If the phone slept through the end with nothing playing, TikTok stays open rather than closing on you the next morning.
* New patch, Stop recording watch history, with a Privacy switch that stays off until you turn it on. It holds back the view report TikTok sends for each video you watch, which is how videos get into Activity center > Watch history. Your views stop adding to view counts and For You has less to learn from, and TikTok still sees likes, follows, searches and its own usage logs. Videos already in Watch history stay.
* Hushfeed settings > Feed filter > Seen videos has two new rows, Save seen history to a file and Restore seen history from a file. Save writes the signed-in account's seen videos, and when each was seen, to a JSON file that doesn't name the account or carry any settings, and the row says plainly that the file is viewing history. Restore checks the whole file first, then adds it to the account that chose it. A video in both keeps the newer date, and the banner counts what was added and what was already there, too old, dated ahead of the phone's clock or past the 10,000-video limit. Switching accounts or stopping a slow file app before the merge changes nothing, and a save the file app already has is reported once it answers. TikTok's own data export still goes through Import watch history.
* The Blocked caption words and Hidden LIVE categories editors in Hushfeed settings > Feed filter have a sample box now. Type a caption or a category under your rules and the editor says which rule matches it, that nothing matches, or what's wrong with a rule, before you save anything. It runs the same matching the feed uses, and it only covers these word rules, not every filter. Nothing is saved, counted or sent while you try it.
* Screen time has a new switch, Don't start the first video, off by default (#83). When you open TikTok from its icon the first video in the feed waits for one tap, the same catcher Don't start the feed on returning uses, with the tab bar still free. Opening TikTok from a link, a notification (including the ones TikTok sends as an icon tap) or a shortcut isn't held, and neither is a reopen from Recents. The catcher now also leaves room for a tab bar drawn after it went up.
* The Video, Photo and Comment media filename editors in Hushfeed settings > Downloads now preview the template as you type it. You see the folder and file name a made-up post would get from Hushfeed's downloader and from TikTok's own, plus the sound, details and subtitle files you have on, and anything in braces that isn't a token is named so a typo doesn't go unnoticed until the next save. {original} and {media_id} get their own note under Hushfeed's downloader, which keeps them as typed.
* New patch, Run beside the store app, for a second TikTok next to the one from the store. Morphe's Clone app patch already gives the patched app a new package name so Android installs both, but the renamed copy registered your phone under that new name, TikTok's servers didn't give it a device ID, and logging in failed. Select this patch with Clone app and the copy registers under TikTok's own name, while each app keeps its own data and login. A build that keeps TikTok's package name isn't touched, and pausing Hushfeed puts the copy's own name back. Google and Facebook sign-in can't work in a renamed copy, so log in there with your email or phone number. It isn't selected by default.
* Diagnostics has a new row, Log diagnostics for 15 minutes. Tap it before you reproduce a bug and everything is logged for a quarter hour, then logging stops by itself. The row shows when it ends and a second tap stops it early. Restarting TikTok keeps the same end, setting the phone's clock back can't stretch it, and a phone restart ends it. It never moves the Log diagnostics switch, so logging you left on stays on, and backups leave it out. The Log diagnostics switch now says plainly that it stays on until you turn it off.
* Block the advertising id in Device privacy guard now covers every place TikTok reads it. Two ad SDKs inside the app ask Google's ad service for the id on their own instead of going through Play Services, and they still got the real one. With the switch on they get the blank id too, and every check of whether you've opted out of ads personalization says you have, which is what Android tells apps once you delete your advertising id. Pause Hushfeed still hands TikTok the real answers.
* New patch, Network proxy. Set an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy in Hushfeed settings > Region, restart TikTok, and its own network stack sends the feed, search, comments and the rest of its API through it. Plain Java connections go through it too. Videos and LIVE streams stay direct, because TikTok's player opens its own connections. TikTok's network stack can't sign in to a proxy, so a user name and password only reach the Java side, and the password never goes into a settings backup. If the proxy doesn't answer when TikTok starts, a message says so. Other apps aren't affected, and it's off by default.
* New patch, Picture-in-picture. Turn on Keep watching in a small window in Hushfeed settings > Playback, and when you leave TikTok while a video plays it keeps going over your other apps with just the video showing, no buttons or caption. It's off by default.
* New patch, Always upload in HD. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, under Posting, and every video you post goes through TikTok's own HD upload, just as if you'd switched HD on yourself on the post page. A clip TikTok doesn't count as high quality posts the way it always did. While it's on, turning HD off on the post page won't stick. It's off by default.
* New patch, Keep pulled sounds. When a sound gets pulled for copyright or in your region, TikTok mutes every video that uses it. Turn on Play sounds TikTok pulled in Hushfeed settings > Playback and those videos play with their audio again, in the feed and in search. TikTok may still show the sound as unavailable. It's off by default.
* Region spoof has a new switch, Match region fields in requests, in Hushfeed settings > Region. Every request TikTok sends carries the region its servers last saved on your phone and your network's country code, and neither one followed the preset before. With the switch on, both do. The other region fields in a request already follow Match locale and timezone to country. It's off by default.
* LIVE controls has a second switch, Show exact LIVE viewer counts, under Hushfeed settings > Playback. A LIVE room's viewer count at the top right shows the real number, like 1,234, instead of TikTok's rounded 1.2K, and so does the count in a programmed LIVE, collapsed, expanded or in landscape. It's off by default.
* New patch, LIVE controls. A LIVE that shows up in your feed can count down and drop you into the room without a tap. Turn on Stop LIVE previews opening by themselves in Hushfeed settings > Playback and it stays a preview until you tap it. It's off by default.
* Device privacy guard picks up two more switches under Privacy, both off until you turn them on. Hide a VPN connection keeps TikTok from telling you're on a VPN, and only the VPN reads as off to it, so your other connections stay as they are. Block the advertising id hands TikTok the blank id Android gives after you reset yours, so this device can't be matched across apps by it. Both take effect without a restart, and Pause Hushfeed gives TikTok your real VPN state and id back.
* New patch, Stop search autoplay. Turn on Stop search results playing on their own in Hushfeed settings > App and the videos in your search results stay on their cover until you open one. The feed plays as usual.
* Ghost mode has a new Hide online status switch under it in Hushfeed settings > Privacy. With both on, TikTok stops sending the activity report that shows your friends a green dot or Active now while you're in the app. That same report brings back your friends' status, so theirs may stop updating for you while it's on. It's off by default.
* Look like the store app can now name a different store as TikTok's installer. Pick Play Store (still the default), Galaxy Store, AppGallery or Amazon Appstore under the switch in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
* Swipe for brightness and volume, a new switch under Feed screen > Gestures, lets you drag up or down along the left edge of a video to change the screen brightness, or along the right edge to change the volume, with a small level shown on screen. It works on the feed and on a video opened from a profile. A drag that starts anywhere else still scrolls the feed, and a tap does what it always did. Edge strip width sets how wide the edges are, from 5 to 30 percent of the screen. It's off until you turn it on, and the brightness goes back to your phone's setting when you leave the video.
* Hide inbox items now reaches inside a chat too. Under Inbox > In a chat there are three new switches, all off until you turn them on: Hide call buttons takes the voice and video call buttons off the top of a chat, Hide sticker suggestions drops the sticker banner, and Hide suggested replies stops TikTok's reply suggestions and the banner that introduces them. The chat details button and everything you send are left as they were.
* Fade the video controls, a new number under Clear display, dims the buttons, caption, music disc, search bar and tabs over the video to the level you pick instead of hiding them, which helps against screen burn-in while you can still see where everything is. 100 leaves TikTok as it is, and faded controls still take taps. At 0 the buttons and caption are hidden the way Clear display hides them, and the tabs stay at 10 so you can still find your way around.
* Lock the feed, a new switch under Screen time, keeps For You, Following and the other feed tabs behind a calm panel, and the feed won't swipe. Inbox, profiles and search work as usual, a link to one video still opens that video, and the app opens on Inbox instead of a feed you've shut. The Friends tab's feed is covered too, and clearing the controls doesn't lift the panel. Only a link to a single video gets through, not a profile or a search link. With Wait a day to loosen the budget on, turning Lock the feed off waits until the day starts over, the same as a longer budget does. It's off until you turn it on, and Pause Hushfeed turns it off with everything else.
* New patch, Block popups. Its checklist under Feed screen > Popups lists each popup TikTok has tried to show on your phone, like the follow-your-friends card, and stops the ones you tick the next time they come up. Nothing is blocked until you tick something. CAPTCHA, verification, sign-in, age, ban and legal consent screens never show up in the list and are never blocked.
* New patch, Story controls. Two switches under Playback, both off until you turn them on. Loop a story replays a story from the start when it ends instead of moving to the next one, and Hold a photo story keeps a photo on screen until you tap or swipe. Tap or swipe still moves on either way.
* Export comments, a new switch under Comments, adds Export CSV and Export JSON under the comment search box. Each one saves the comments and replies the video has loaded to a file you pick, with the author, text, time, likes, reply count, pinned, creator liked, picture count and language for every row, and a count beside the buttons that matches the rows in the file. Open the reply threads you want first, since TikTok only loads a thread's replies when you do. If your file app stalls, the app offers Stop waiting. It's off until you turn it on, and it needs Search within comments.
* Remove feed ads now also keeps the "Find fresh ideas on Lemon8" card out of For You. It's an install promo TikTok slots between videos, so no ad flag marks it. Hushfeed stops TikTok asking for it and drops it from the feed if one arrives anyway, and it shows up in the feed filter report under Ads.
* New patch, App lock. Turn on Lock TikTok under Privacy and TikTok asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock PIN when it starts, and again when you come back after the delay you pick (right away, or after 1, 5 or 15 minutes). Nothing shows and the video stays stopped until you unlock. A link you open from another app still lands on its video once you're in, and TikTok's preview in recent apps is blank while the lock is on. Android 9 and up use the system's unlock prompt, and older phones get the screen lock check. A phone with no screen lock opens TikTok as before and says why. Pause Hushfeed leaves the lock on, so pausing isn't a way past it.
* Advanced downloads can save a photo post as one MP4 with its sound. Turn on Save photo posts as a video under Downloads. TikTok's Download video on a one-photo post then makes a clean video with no logo, handle or end card, and a post with several photos asks whether you want the photos you picked or a video of them. Each photo shows for 3 seconds by default (Seconds per photo goes from 1 to 10), the sound is cut or repeated to fit, and if it can't be fetched the video saves silent and the notice tells you.
* New patch, Prefer H.264 playback. Turn on Prefer H.264 video under Playback and a video TikTok also offers in H.264 plays that version instead of HEVC or ByteVC2, which can help a phone that stutters or runs hot. A video without one plays as before. With Play SDR instead of HDR or Playback quality on too, they pick among the H.264 versions.
* New patch, Show engagement rate. Its switch under Feed screen > Video info works out a video's likes, comments, shares and saves as a percentage of its views, from the counts TikTok already sent with it, so nothing extra is downloaded. The rate shows after the creator's name on the video you're watching and after the view count on profile grids, like 12.3K · 4.2%. A video without a view count shows nothing.
* New Show exact counts switch in Feed screen > Right column. It shows likes, comments, shares and other counts as the full number, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M, using your phone's digit grouping.
* New patch, Custom launcher icon. It gives TikTok's icon a themed layer, so with themed icons on in Android 13 and up the note takes your wallpaper's color. Its Icon style option also swaps in a black background, or a plain white-on-black or black-on-white note, on Android 8 and up.
* New patch, Lift text length limits. Its switch under Comments > Writing lets a comment, a repost note or your bio run past the length TikTok's app stops typing at, instead of cutting you off at the counter. TikTok's servers still decide how long a text they'll take.
* New patch, Remove avatar rings. Two switches under Feed screen > Right column take the story ring and the pulsing LIVE ring off profile pictures on the feed and in comments, and the story ring off profiles too. With them on, tapping the picture opens the creator's profile instead of their story or their LIVE.
* New patch, Play SDR instead of HDR. Turn it on under Playback and videos that also come in HDR play their standard version, so the screen doesn't jump to full brightness when one starts. A video TikTok only offers in HDR still plays. With Playback quality on too, it picks among the standard versions.
* New patch, Copy bio and IDs. Long-press a profile's bio to copy it. The share sheet a profile's menu opens gets Copy username and Copy user ID buttons, and a video's share sheet gets Copy video ID. Each copy says what it copied in a toast. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App > Copy bio and IDs.
* New patch, Show follow status. Open a profile that follows you and "Follows you" shows under its @username. If you follow it and it doesn't follow you back, it says that instead. Your follower and following lists mark the accounts you follow that don't follow you back. It uses the follow status TikTok already sends, so nothing extra is fetched. Switch: Hushfeed settings > App > Show follow status.
* Feed filter has a new Show only mutual friends on the Friends tab switch. With it on, the Friends tab drops posts, reposts and LIVEs from accounts you follow that don't follow you back, and from strangers and suggested accounts. A friend's repost stays even when the video is someone else's, and your own posts and reposts always stay.
* Hide AI-generated videos catches a lot more now. Besides TikTok's visible AI label, it reads the AI marks TikTok keeps on a post without always showing them: the creator's AI disclosure, TikTok's own moderation verdict, AI sources in the content credentials (C2PA), posts made with TikTok's AI effects like AI Alive, AI remix and AI portrait, and tags like #ai or #aigenerated. The filter report counts each one under AiSignals by the mark that caught it. Feed filter also covers the newer version of the Friends tab feed, so its rules apply there too.
* Show where a video was posted now works on videos where TikTok hides the post time, which is most of For You unless Always show publish date is on. It also shows on videos you open from search, a creator's profile or a shared link, and it switches to the right country as soon as an opened video starts instead of keeping the one from the feed. A long name gets shortened a little so the country isn't cut off along with it.
* In Feature Gate Lab, turning overrides on from a gate's own page now unlocks its Forced result switch right away. Before, it stayed greyed out until you left the page and came back.
* Remove LIVE extras now says in its description that it can take away the red and blue battle score bar and the co-host guests' names in LIVE. It's off unless you pick it, so leave it unticked if you watch battles.
* Drop the animated image cache works differently now (#100). The old version threw away cached frames, so animated stickers and GIFs stuttered and memory use didn't go down. Now TikTok keeps only the frame on screen for each animation and stops decoding frames ahead of time, and each next frame is drawn from the one before it.
* Hide the Clear display controls moved to Feed screen > Clear display, right under Automatic clear display, instead of the end of Around the video.
* Clear display now keeps the bottom tabs (Home, Friends, Inbox, Profile) away on the main feed until it ends. With Automatic clear display on, they could stay over the first video after TikTok was opened fresh. Other pages, like Inbox opened from a notification, keep their tabs.
* With Automatic clear display on and no delay, the next video stays cleared while you swipe to it, instead of showing its buttons, caption, progress bar and tabs for a moment (#84). Tapping Restore display still brings everything back.
* In Clear display, the search, place or product link under the caption can't be tapped by accident anymore, and neither can the wide search bar newer TikTok versions put at the bottom. TikTok only faded it out, so a tap near the bottom of a video could open a search you couldn't see (#84).
* Clear display now also takes the Add comment bar off photos and videos you open from search or a profile, and Restore display brings it back (#84). Before, it stayed at the bottom unless Hide the comment bar on opened videos was on.
* With Hide the Clear display controls on, the progress bar is still there to drag, just invisible, so you can move through a video along the bottom edge without leaving Clear display (#84).
* Feature Gate Lab has 13 new reviewed presets for features other TikTok mods unlock by flag. There's repost with a comment, the profile banner with the new profile layout, live photo, camera and audio comments, comments saved to Favorites, comment sort and dislike styles, message bubble colors with the Inbox archive and sharing to more chats at once, Manage topics, visual search, AI Self, the long-press menu on every post, TikTok's own hold to speed up, its background play and auto-scroll, and post dates in the feed. Every preset was checked against 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4. Show See translation was 47.1.3 only and now covers all three. The list shows just the presets for the TikTok you have installed. Some of these features also depend on what TikTok's servers allow for your account.
* Remove ads now also catches creator posts TikTok runs as ads. They don't carry TikTok's ad flag, so they were getting through, but TikTok marks them in the post's commerce details and Hushfeed reads the same mark TikTok does. The filter report counts them under AdSignals. Skip the splash ad also stops the startup tasks that preload TopView takeover ads and ask the server for a real-time splash.
* Feed filter has a new Hide unpersonalized For You videos switch. It hides the fill-in videos TikTok pads For You with when it hasn't picked anything for you, the ones it sends from its for_you_page_999 pool with no reason attached. If a whole batch is fill-in, the batch stays, so the feed never stalls on it. The filter report counts each For You batch by the pool TikTok says it came from, next to how many the switch took out. Creator exceptions get through it the same way they get through the other preference filters.
* Searching Hushfeed's settings puts a setting whose name matches above one that only mentions those words in its description, so "original photos" now lists Download original photos first and Photo filename after it. Searching "debug", "debugging", "logs" or "logging" finds Log diagnostics, and each translation has its own words for it too.
* A photo TikTok only sends as HEIF now has a second way to become a JPEG. Samsung's image decoder turns TikTok's HEIF down, so Hushfeed reads it the way the phone's media scanner does instead, and keeps the file TikTok sent only when neither one can read it.
* What's new can show a release in the phone's language now (#91). The 0.68.0 and 0.67.1 notes are translated into all eight languages Hushfeed's settings come in, and older releases stay in English with a short line saying so.
* With debug logging on, the diagnostic file now lists each share sheet item Hushfeed hides, which row it sat in and what kind of view it was (#120). People in the Send to row are listed without their names. It's there to pin down why TikTok's smaller share sheet loses its rows when something is hidden.
* The FAQ on Hushfeed's GitHub page explains the pure black Profile and Inbox some people see without AMOLED dark theme. It comes from TikTok 47.1.4's own dark mode, and a build without that patch shows the same colors with Hushfeed paused (#69).
* The troubleshooting guide on Hushfeed's GitHub page now answers whether Feature Gate Lab can hide CAPTCHA popups (it can't), and walks through trying one of the Lab's reviewed presets (#111).
